Established in 1980, HomeFirst™ is a nonprofit organization passionately working to end homelessness. We serve the Bay Area community through low\-barrier programming and systems leadership – meeting each person where they are by offering support and resources that address immediate and long\-term housing needs. With nearly 45 years of experience, we view housing as a fundamental human right and understand that solving homelessness requires a collaborative effort.

* ***Passion****: We ignite change to fulfill our mission.*
* ***Excellence****: We deliver exceptional service to our communities.*

We offer a 401(k)\-retirement plan with generous matching, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits, and workers’ compensation. HomeFirst is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law. jobs.title: Community Health Advocate / Child Watch
jobs.description:
#### **POSITION SUMMARY:**


The Community Health Advocate (CHA) / Child Watch under the supervision of the Program Manager \- BIH, provides on\-site supervision to children ages 1 month to 12 years while parents attend prenatal, postpartum, and/or other BIH related group activities. Knowledge of appropriate child development theories and practices. Ability to create and maintain a safe learning environment for children. Ability to work effectively with children, parents, and program staff. Effective oral and written communication skills; sensitive to the needs of small children. May work up to 20 hours per week as needed for program demands.


#### **QUALIFICATIONS:**


1\. Education: High school diploma or equivalent. A typical way of obtaining the knowledge, skills and abilities outlined above is completion of six (6\) units of early childhood education or child development (with a grade of “C” or better) from an accredited college/university; or 4 months of ROP Training in a Child Development Program.


2\. Certification: Certification in Infant and Pediatric CPR and First Aid must be met within 30 days of assignment. Must successfully pass the background check. NegativeTB test required upon hire and must be maintained every four (4\) years.


3\. Brand Ambassador: Ability to project a positive image to the public.


4\. Experience: At least one (1\) year of experience working as a childcare aide, teacher aide or higher position.


5\. Mental and Physical Skills: The Community Health Advocate (CHA) / Child Watch occasionally is required to climb, stoop, kneel, or crouch. Frequently required to talk or hear. Ability to lift children up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus to view documents. Regularly required to use oral communication skills; read information and documents; solve problems; and establish and maintain effective working relationships with BIH program staff, participants (parents) and their children ages 1month – 12years.


6\. Interpersonal and Time Management Skills: Active listening, empathy, and cultural competence required. Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing in a professional manner. Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment, with rapidly shifting priorities and competing demands while maintaining attention to detail.


7\. Other: Ability to remain calm and courteous in a high stress environment. CHA / Child Watch should be able to work independently with minimal direction.

#### **EXAMPLES OF DUTIES:**


1\. Sets up child watch room/area prior to arrival of children.


2\. Assists in developing and maintaining a safe environment for children.


3\. Ensures that children engage in age\-appropriate activities/play (including watching of movies or videos);


4\. Provides emotional and physical support as appropriate to children and encourages high self\-esteem.


5\. Escorts of children who are toilet trained in the restroom and may change diapers for other children as needed.


6\. Supervises snack\-time (food to be provided by BIH program or child’s parent). Cleans up child watch room/area at the conclusion of child watch assignment.


7\. Other Duties as Assigned. Child Watch will attend and actively participate in training and care coordination meetings. This includes, but is not limited to, assisting with Black Infant Health Program events for BIH participants.

#### **GENERAL REQUIREMENTS:**


1\. Attends work regularly and punctually.


2\. Provides care appropriate to the age of the infants / children served


3\. Works cooperatively with BIH Program Coordinator, Public Health Nurse, Mental Health Professional, Community Outreach Liaison, BIH staff members, and other Baywell Health staff persons, as required.


4\. Treats all participants / clients / visitors with respect and courtesy.


5\. Remains competent in skills required for position.


6\. During the initial thirty (30\) days of employment, becomes and remains knowledgeable about and in compliance with Baywell Health and Black Infant Health Program policies and procedures in the following areas:


a. Confidentiality of patient / participant / fellow employee and supplier records b. Professional and business ethics.



c. Continuous quality and improvement.



d. Safety and security of person and property.



e. Infection control.



f. Hazardous materials and waste.



g. Life safety and emergency preparedness.


#### **About Baywell Health**


There’s healthcare and then there’s Baywell Health: your trusted partner in enhancing the health and dignity of the Bay Area’s Black community. We are dedicated to promoting optimal health and well\-being through compassionate, comprehensive care that values and supports every individual and family we serve. Our services span Gynecology \& Women’s Reproductive Adult Medicine Optometry Pediatrics Behavioral Health Oral Health Assisted Treatment Pharmacy Healthy Communities Covid\-19 Services We welcome you to apply here and join our team delivering healthcare to the community.

jobs.title: Black Infant Health - Program Manager
jobs.description:
#### **POSITION SUMMARY:**


The Black Infant Health (BIH) Program is meant to address the problem of poor birth outcomes and health disparities that affect African American women and their babies. The BIH program features a standard set of services that features group intervention and social service case management to help reduce stress, build resilience, promote healthy behaviors, and increase social support. The BIH Program Manager will have day to day responsibility for leadership of the BIH program and oversee all program team members and partners. This includes developing relationships with community\-based collectives, community\-based organization partners, and management of the Community Advisory Board. The position also includes management of project timelines and deliverables for timely and effective execution of the Work Plan and responsibility for project reporting. Ongoing and timely communication with Alameda County Public Health Department and other community partners will be expected as well. This position supports Alameda County’s BIH Program Area 2, covering families who reside in West Oakland, Emeryville, North Oakland and South Berkeley.


#### **QUALIFICATIONS:**


1\. Education: Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university program in Social Work, Public Health, Nursing, Education, Health Education, or other health related or social science field plus five years of management experience in a health/public health or social service setting is required; or Master’s Degree from an accredited college or university program in Social Work, Public Health, Nursing, Education, Health Education, or other health related or social science field.


2\. Experience: Lived understanding of African American culture and history, and general working knowledge of family systems, community trauma, and community organizing or advocacy. Experience in serving Black birthing and parenting individuals, providing family support, and offering home visiting services is key. At least five years of professional administrative experience in public health or a related field, including two years of supervisory experience.


3\. CA Department of Public Health Approval: The BIH Program Manager must be approved by the California Department of Public Health (CDPH)/Maternal Child and Adolescent Health (MCAH) BIH Program Consultant prior to appointment.


4\. Black Infant Health Ambassador: Fully embraces and supports the Black Infant Health Governing Concepts of culturally relevant, client\-centered, strength\-based, and cognitive skill\-building approaches.


5\. Cultural Competence: Demonstrates cultural competence. Demonstrates ability to implement and maintain a culturally relevant BIH Program that recruits, trains, and retains staff who reflect and respond to the values of the African American community served by BIH.


6\. Knowledge of Public Health: Demonstrates knowledge of the following: women’s health, including prenatal and postpartum health; life course perspective; infant behavior and development; health education, including breastfeeding, nutrition, and physical activity; and local community and social services.


7\. Advocacy and Outreach Skills: Essential qualifications focus on strong community engagement, population\-based assessment, and evidence\-based service delivery skills, particularly in women's health, infant behavior, health education, and addressing health inequities affecting the Black community. Advocacy and outreach skills will be essential to promote health equity by implementing health programs and health policies that will benefit the community’s health through motivational training.


8\. Interpersonal and Leadership Skills: Possess strong leadership skills. Demonstrates the organizational and interpersonal skills needed to communicate at different levels and work in complex situations. Reflects basic skills of the Health Resources and Services Administration Maternal Child Health Bureau Leadership Competencies 1\-8 (leadership.mchtraining.net).


9\. Computer Skills: Basic computer skills, and capable of using software and technology tools used to manage health data and reporting tools (Excel, Microsoft word, etc.). Experience in managing and tracking health data, navigating Epic and Tableau a plus.


10\. Other: Should be able to remain calm and courteous in a high stress environment. Should be able to work independently with minimal direction.

#### **EXAMPLE OF DUTIES:**


1\. Program Management: Responsible for the management and coordination of local BIH program activities and staff. Maintains confidentiality and adheres to Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) regulations. Provides supervision and professional development for staff; including assignment responsibilities and preparing performance evaluations. Prepares the BIH program budget and monitors expenditures. Prepares administrative, financial documents and transactions for completion, and gathers and compiles information for biannual reports.


2\. Conduct community outreach and need assessments. The BIH program manager will plan, develop, and provide oversight outreach campaigns to enroll pregnant African American women into the Black Infant Health program. Will conduct needs assessments and guide the research, and analysis of statistical and other data to report healthy birth outcomes and effectiveness of the BIH program. Will develop outreach and program literature to raise awareness of African American infant and maternal mortality rates.


3\. Program reporting and grant writing. Manages BIH scope of work to meet annual objectives; evaluates program needs and develops effective program activities and services to educate and empower clients in meeting their healthcare and related needs. Research and write grant proposals and agenda reports.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Do you have experience in operations, project management, marketing operations or brand management? Are you a proactive, resourceful and dependable professional that thrives in small start\-up environments wearing multiple hats and managing multiple projects concurrently? Do you subscribe to the wisdom of working smarter not harder?



If you said yes to these questions, consider joining our team of thirteen (13\) dedicated professionals as our first Operations Manager! We’re looking for a high\-agency Operations Manager to work on\-site directly alongside the founder of a small, but growing, skincare company based in Concord, CA, that creates products that produce clinical results, while tapping into whole\-plant wisdom and focusing on inclusiveness in the beauty space.



The Operations Manager will serve as the central project manager and operational point person, helping coordinate product launches, marketing execution, manage the company’s social media, provide support to our vendors, our creative partners, our professional accounts, and our customers while handling the day\-to\-day business priorities. This is a hands\-on, roll\-up\-your\-sleeves position for someone who loves creating order from complexity, thrives in a fast\-moving entrepreneurial environment, and knows how to take ideas, priorities, and unfinished projects and move them through to completion without constant direction and/or oversight.


**Knowledge Skills and Abilities**


* At least three (3\) years’ experience in operations, project management, marketing operations, brand management, or a similar cross\-functional role in a start\-up environment.
* Demonstrable project management skills. Exceptionally organized, dependable, resourceful, and proactive with the natural ability to follow up and close loops.
* Proven track record managing multiple projects, partners, and deadlines without losing track of details. Can prioritize effectively without constant direction.
* Intermediate to advanced competency with Google Workspace Suite and/or spreadsheets.
* Intermediate to advanced competency with ChatGPT, Claude or other modern AI tools. Ability to use AI thoughtfully for writing, research, organization, project management, and workflow efficiency. Understands that AI is a working tool, not a substitute for judgment, fact\-checking, or strong writing.
* Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Asana, AirTable, MS Project).
* Familiarity with social media management platforms (e.g., Buffer, Hootsuite, Sprout Social).
* Familiarity with omni\-channel marketing tools (e.g., Klaviyo, OmniSend, ActiveCampaign).
* Strong written communication skills. Able to take rough notes, voice memos, feedback, or a creative brief and turn them into a strong first draft.
* Strong verbal communication skills. Comfortable communicating directly with customers, vendors, consultants, creators, and professional partners.
* Proven ability to create systems that make work easier rather than more complicated.


*Preferred Qualifications*


* Previous experience in the beauty industry.
* Project management certification (e.g., CAPM, PMP).
* Previous e\-commerce experience.
* Experience integrating diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into organizational decision\-making.
* Previous experience working in a start\-up environment with fast\-moving, creative principal(s).


*Personal Attributes*


* Professional maturity to maintain composure during shifting priorities and/or tight deadlines
* Proactive ability to anticipate and recognize operational needs and present solutions.
* Ability to recognize when to move independently and when something genuinely needs founder input.
* Strong work ethic with a learning orientation, particularly around technology.


**Physical Requirements**



This position works primarily in an open office environment while regularly accessing the warehouse/production areas. Able to perform the following duties with or without accommodation:

* Stand/sit for the duration of the scheduled shift. Sit at a desk, conference room or workstation for more than three (3\) hours at a time.

jobs.title: CRM Product & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**


What We're Looking For:


We're looking for a CRM Product \& Operations Manager to own the strategy, delivery, and day\-to\-day health of our Salesforce and Salesforce CPQ ecosystem. You'll lead the CRM product lifecycle end to end — from discovery and prioritization through release, adoption, and production support — partnering closely with Sales, RevOps, Deal Desk, Customer Experience, Finance, IT, and Engineering across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.


Join a collaborative, globally distributed BizApps team that partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to turn requirements and operational needs into scalable, user\-friendly solutions. The team moves with purpose, embraces continuous improvement, and values ownership, transparency, innovation, and shared success.

  

What You'll Do:

* Own and evolve the CRM product roadmap for Salesforce and Salesforce CPQ, balancing business priorities, platform enhancements, technical dependencies, and production stability.
* Partner with Sales, RevOps, Deal Desk, Customer Experience, Finance, IT, and Engineering to translate business needs into prioritized, scalable CRM solutions.
* Own hiring, performance management, and day\-to\-day people leadership for the CRM team, ensuring clear ownership and accountability across product, operations, and support workstreams.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 1\-4 CRM analysts/administrators, setting priorities, providing regular feedback, and supporting their growth and career development.
* Own and prioritize the CRM product backlog — enhancements, defects, and operational requests — based on business value, user impact, effort, and risk.
* Lead CRM initiatives through the full product lifecycle: discovery, requirements definition, development, testing, release, adoption, and post\-production evaluation.
* Lead day\-to\-day Salesforce/CPQ operations, production support, and system administration, including investigation of complex incidents, root cause analysis, and preventative fixes.
* Manage QA and release activities — test planning, UAT, release validation — and lead sprint planning and sprint reviews.
* Manage Jira workflows for enhancements, defects, and support requests, and drive process improvements through automation, documentation, and self\-service capabilities.
* Improve CRM adoption, usability, and data quality by identifying friction points and simplifying business processes.
* Manage user access, permissions, and administrative operations, and support integrations and troubleshooting across Salesforce, NetSuite, Boomi, AWS, Snowflake, and Tableau.
* Define and monitor product and operational metrics to measure platform health, adoption, support efficiency, and release effectiveness.
* Lead software license audits and optimization across enterprise platforms, and manage vendor and contractor relationships, invoicing, and delivery.
* Support business\-critical operations during high\-volume periods (month\-end/quarter\-end) and evaluate emerging Salesforce and AI capabilities for the roadmap.

  

What You'll Bring:

* 15\+ years of overall IT experience, with relevant experience in technology, software engineering, and enterprise applications. 6\+ years of experience in CRM product management, business systems analysis, or Salesforce administration, including 2\+ years supporting Salesforce CPQ.
* Salesforce Administrator certification required; Advanced Administrator or CPQ Specialist certification strongly preferred.
* Proven experience owning a product backlog and leading Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, reviews, backlog grooming).
* Experience with production support, incident management, and root cause analysis in an enterprise SaaS environment.
* Hands\-on experience with Jira for workflow, release, and defect management.
* Familiarity with connected enterprise systems (NetSuite, Boomi, AWS, Snowflake, Tableau) and cross\-system troubleshooting.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering across Sales, RevOps, Finance, and Engineering in a global organization.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience supporting global, multi\-region teams (Americas, EMEA, APAC) preferred.
* The ability to legally work in the country of hire is required for this position.


What We Offer:

* Flexible paid time off that allows you to have an enhanced work\-life balance.
* Excellent medical, dental, and vision options.
* 401k matching, life insurance, commuter benefits, and parental leave plans.
* Complimentary CalmApp subscription for you and your loved ones, because mental wellness matters.
* ClassPass corporate discount code.
* Energetic work environment with a hybrid work style, providing the balance you need.
* Thrive within our inclusive community and seize ongoing professional development opportunities to elevate your career.

Compensation Overview

Where You'll Work:


Work Location : 275 Shoreline Drive, Suite 150, Redwood City, CA 9406

  

Our Story


At Meltwater, we believe that when you have the right people in the right environment, great things happen.


Our best\-in\-class technology empowers our 27,000 customers around


the world to make better business decisions through data. But we can’t do that without our global team of developers, innovators, problem\-solvers, and high\-performers who embrace challenges and find new solutions for our customers.

jobs.description:
The **Business Operations Manager** will support the **space program** located in **Moffett Field, CA** for the center's occupational safety, health, medical and system safety and mission assurance programs. Leads business operation functions including financial management, security, timekeeping, HR, accounts payable, procurement and business systems. The position participates closely with company program management, company project leads, corporate office, and has some direct customer interface.  



  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Monitor and report program commitments, obligations, expenditures, contract performance, and program status execution to include program milestones, schedule and cost.
* Prepare, monitor, and update program requirements and spend plans.
* Reviews funding modifications to ensure they are accurate and tracked to assigned functional areas and projects.
* Prepare NASA financial reports (monthly and quarterly).
* Analyze contract expenses, identify financial issues, and implement corrective actions.
* Perform financial modeling including revenue, direct labor, and other direct costs.
* Develop task order proposals and modifications.
* Develop estimates for materials, equipment, and services with supporting competitive documentation.
* Initiate purchase requisitions for approved purchases.
* Supports the program manager with special projects.
* Tracks deliverables for the program management office.
* Back\-up to the general administrative role for coverage purposes.
* Other duties as assigned.

**REQUIRED:**

***This position has been posted at multiple levels (must meet minimum level indicated). Depending on the candidate's experience, requirements, and business needs, we reserve the right to consider candidates at any level for which this position has been advertised.***

  

* This position requires US Citizenship or Permanent Resident status due to the sensitivity of customer related information.
* This position requires a Public Trust Clearance, or the ability to obtain one.
* Must have a **bachelor's degree** in the field of business finance, accounting or a related field.
* Must have **6\+** years of recent and related work experience; at least three (3\) years of professional experience working within the Planning, Programming, Budgeting and Execution (PPBE) process.
* Managing, negotiating and administering federal contracts, and subcontracts for cost, T\&M, and FFP type orders.
* Experience in building and working with financial models.
* Excellent decision\-making ability, written and interpersonal communication skills and the interpersonal disposition aligned to high frequency interaction.
* Accountability, appreciate teamwork and deadline\-driven work schedule.

**DESIRED:**

* Experience working as a government contractor or on government contracts.
* Experience using Deltek/Costpoint.

 **WORK LOCATION:**

* This position offers a hybrid work schedule; some travel may be required.
* Schedules are subject to change based on the requirements of the position and/or customer needs.

 **BACKGROUND INVESTIGATIONS REQUIRED:**


All Bastion employees must be able to pass a national agency check and some positions require clearance and will require an extensive background verification/check process.

 **DRUG AND ALCOHOL SCREENING REQUIRED:**


All Bastion employees must be able to pass a pre\-employment drug screen and are required to participate in periodic random drug and alcohol screenings.

 **STANDARD BASTION REQUIREMENTS:**

* Must have experience with Microsoft Office Suite, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and TEAMS.
* All of Bastion's employees must be team players with strong work ethics and must be culture oriented.
* Able to communicate effectively, verbally and in written form, with internal and external customers.
* Able to follow company programs, processes, procedures, practices, requirements, goals, and objectives.
* Must be organized with good time management skills and must be able to work outside normal schedule and adjust schedule to meet peak periods and surge requirements.
* Generally, an office environment, but can involve inside or outside work depending on the task.
* Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods (90% of the time) and may require lifting and carrying up to 25 lbs. (5% of the time).
* Regular attendance in accordance with an established work schedule is critical.

 **BASTION BENEFITS:**


Bastion offers a wide range of benefits for their full\-time employees; medical, prescription, dental, vision, AD\&D, disability benefits, life insurance, retirement 401k, vacation, sick pay, holidays, flexible work schedules (when available), along with many other options. Our culture is based on strong business ethics, integrity, and professionalism. Our team members are known for their initiative and high\-quality work. When it comes to our employees, we value, respect, and help them grow in their careers.

At Bastion, we are passionate about our people and our safety culture. Individual thoughts, opinions, and perspectives bring value and help us develop solutions for challenging problems, they make us more inventive, and more resilient.

$140K to $170K, salary will depend on education and experience.

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status.

  

Bastion participates in e\-Verify.

jobs.title: New Ventures Technology & Innovation | Strategy & Operations | Manager, Strategic Initiatives
jobs.description:
**New Ventures Technology \& Innovation \- Manager Strategy, Growth \& Transformation**  

  

The Manager, Strategic Initiatives supports the Strategic Initiatives Leader and Senior Manager in executing NVTI's highest\-priority programs. The role provides structured analysis, coordination, and follow\-through across a portfolio spanning product governance, strategic external partnerships, and firm\-level cross\-functional initiatives.  

  

The role requires a working understanding of the alliances and start\-up ecosystem, along with the organizational awareness to navigate Deloitte's matrixed environment across businesses, enabling functions, and Global. The Manager builds productive relationships, coordinates stakeholders, and helps advance agreed priorities without direct authority.  

  

This role is designed for a manager who can translate strategic direction into well\-organized execution: breaking complex work into clear activities, developing senior\-leader materials with guidance, tracking progress across concurrent workstreams, identifying risks, and escalating issues with practical options to sustain pace and quality.  

  

**Estimated Date of Closure October 9, 2026**  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

**Strategic Program Execution**  

* Portfolio Management
	+ Track progress across multiple concurrent NVTI workstreams and maintain accurate visibility into priorities, dependencies, owners, and decision points.
	+ Identify execution risks, analyze impacts, and escalate issues with practical mitigation options for leadership consideration.
	+ Support operating discipline across workstreams through clear plans, follow\-up, status reporting, and accountability routines.
* Senior Leader Support
	+ Develop materials that support senior\-leader decision\-making, including structured briefings, options, status updates, and draft recommendations for review.
	+ Synthesize complex product, partnership, and governance topics into clear, concise narratives tailored to the audience.
	+ Preparing working sessions and stakeholder engagements on behalf of the Strategic Initiatives team, capture outcomes, and coordinate follow\-through.

  

**Governance \& Investment Prioritization**  

* Start\-up/Emerging Strategy
	+ Support analysis and execution related to start\-up / emerging player strategy, lifecycle management, and platform\-to\-product models where start\-ups could apply.
	+ Translate agreed governance concepts into documented processes, operating mechanisms, and decision forums.
	+ Support prioritization discussions by gathering and organizing inputs, analyzing choices, and documenting decisions and rationale.
* Governance Discipline
	+ Maintain clarity on governance cadence, required decisions, owners, and follow\-through.
	+ Ensure materials and discussions connect strategic objectives to execution implications.

  

Stakeholder Engagement \& Matrixed Influence  

* Cross\-Functional Alignment
	+ Coordinate across businesses, enabling functions, and Global to gather input and support alignment around shared priorities.
	+ Build credibility with stakeholders through preparation, structured thinking, reliable follow\-through, and sound judgment.
	+ Translate stakeholder input into clear next steps, draft decision pathways, and coordinated communications for leadership review.
* Communication
	+ Communicate with clarity, discretion, and appropriate altitude across all levels of the organization.
	+ Balance strategic context with operational specificity so stakeholders understand both the "why" and the "what next."

  

The successful candidate would possess these skills  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

  

**The team**  

  

New Ventures, Technology, and Innovation (NVTI) is a unique team in Enterprise Solutions. Its focus is to rapidly identify, shape, experiment and incubate new business opportunities that leverage leading edge technologies. Our team is focused on the impacts that strategy, innovation, and technology advances are having on Deloitte's marketplace offerings and internal operations. Deloitte's breadth, depth, and scale, combined with our relentless passion for innovation create powerful opportunities to help our clients and our own organization stay ahead of change, deliver impact that matters, and transform complexity and disruption into lasting value.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

**Required Experience:**  

* Bachelor's degree
* 6\+ years of relevant experience in management consulting, strategic initiatives, business operations, portfolio management, program management, or a related business\-focused discipline.
* 1\+ years of experience leading projects or workstreams, including coordinating stakeholders, establishing priorities, managing dependencies, and driving accountability in a matrixed environment.
* Prior experience working independently to translate strategic direction into organized execution, including prioritizing competing demands, synthesizing complex business topics, preparing senior\-leader materials, identifying execution risks, and driving workstreams through completion.

  

**Preferred Experience:**  

* Prior experience supporting product strategy, product governance, product lifecycle, or platform\-to\-product initiatives.
* Prior experience in management consulting or a consulting\-oriented environment, with a demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems, develop practical recommendations, and support senior\-leader decision\-making.
* Prior ex

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager (Contract)
jobs.description:
**About Drivemode:**



Drivemode is a California\-based division of Honda Motor Co., Ltd. We are a small, passionate team of software product innovators helping Honda Automotive be competitive in the Hybrid and Electric Vehicle market. We build application experiences for mobile devices. Are you passionate about creating next\-generation delightful digital experiences for automotive? Maybe you have worked at some notable automotive companies in this capacity? Would you like to work on new products and product categories at Honda and help Honda invent the future of automotive? Then we would like to hear from you!

  


**Why Drivemode:**

Join Drivemode for an exciting startup environment and a vibrant culture that combines impactful work, competitive compensation, and excellent benefits. By becoming a part of our team, you'll contribute to a crucial mission that revolutionizes the way people engage with vehicles, addressing both business needs and the world's environmental challenges. This presents an exceptional opportunity to be at the forefront of innovation and drive Honda's success in the Automotive market.  


**About the role:**
-------------------


We're seeking a highly organized, customer\-obsessed **Product Operations Manager** for our 4W Product Group in Silicon Valley. This pivotal role ensures exceptional customer experience and operational efficiency for our connected vehicle products. You will serve as the operational bridge connecting Engineering, Product, Design, Executive Leadership, and global stakeholders. You will oversee support queue health, manage L2/L3 triage and incident response workflows, optimize support processes, localization strategy, drive Voice of Customer insights and operational improvements across the product lifecycle. This is a unique opportunity to impact customer satisfaction and drive scalable growth at Drivemode directly.  


### **What You'll Do:**


* **Customer Support Enablement:** Contribute building the Customer Support Operations, collaborating with engineers, providing product information, enabling effective troubleshooting, and streamlining escalations.
* **L2/L3 Support Triage \& Queue Management:** Perform daily monitoring and initial triage of Jira support queues (9:00 AM–5:00 PM weekdays PT) across mobile apps and backend systems. Classify severity, troubleshoot reproducible issues, verify context, and route to appropriate teams.
* **Escalation management \& Operational Health:** Oversee incident response workflows, unblock critical issues, and track key operational performance metrics. Track ticket resolution against defined SLOs. Intervene on stalled issues, manage Severity 1 incident escalations to on\-call engineers via Slack/Jira, oversee daily/weekly transition handovers, and report operational performance to executive and external stakeholders weekly/monthly.
* **Stakeholder Alignment:** Act as a critical liaison between core development teams, executive management and regional global offices.
* **Content Management:** Own the creation and maintenance of comprehensive FAQs, product manuals, and knowledge base articles for customers and internal teams. Lead the effective product content creation, localization and review processes.
* **Scale Localization:** Build and scale the localization process as we launch multiple languages across the globe. Manage vendor relationships and deliver the high quality of localization.
* **Operational Project Management:** Lead certain key projects for product launches and feature rollouts, ensuring smooth execution and cross\-functional alignment.
* **Process \& Tooling Improvements:** Analyze workflows, identify inefficiencies, and recommend/implement tools and best practices to optimize product operations. Drive continuous improvement.
* **Voice of Customer (VoC) \& Customer Insights:** Establish and manage systems to collect, analyze, and synthesize customer feedback. Translate insights into actionable product recommendations.
### **Who You Are:**


* **Experience:** 3\+ years in Product Operations, ITSM, Technical Support Management, TAM roles, Customer Operations, Localization (5\+ years of total professional experience, including L2/L3 support background)
* **Languages:** Full professional fluency in Japanese (native/equivalent) and business\-level English (written and spoken) to bridge local and global stakeholders
* **Collaboration \& Resilience:** Outstanding cross\-functional communication and triage judgment under pressure in a fast\-paced environment. Strong ability to build relationships and influence cross\-functional teams in a large corporation that spans across regions
* **Technical Acumen:** Hands\-on experience with Jira, incident workflows, and support tools. Familiarity with mobile applications, cloud services, or connected vehicle/automotive software.
* **Operational Excellence \& Analytical Skills:** Proven track record of optimizing scalable processes, setting up operational KPIs, and translating data into actionable insights.
* **Customer\-Centric:** Deep passion for understanding customer needs and advocating for their experience.
* **Proactive \& Organized:** Self\-motivated, highly organized, and effective in a fast\-paced environment.
### **Nice\-to\-Haves:**


* Ability to read or debug basic code (GitHub, Swift, Server Logs)
* Background in automotive or connected vehicle technology
* User research experience
* Knowledge of product documentation best practices.
$60 \- $75 an hour
This is the position's hourly pay. * Lead new process roll\-out as requested
* Control \& maintain Unit's expense budgets and allocated resources.

* Manage Security (Physical \& Data) at the VAC and to ensure effective controls are in place to pre\-empt any physical / data security breach incidents.
* Work closely with the Value Added Services team in order to create new channels of Revenue.

* Prior experience of managing a mid\-sized team
* Experience in managing processes, as well as leading on projects, a plus.

**Knowledge \& Key Skills:**

* Proficiency in MS office, especially Excel
* Adaptability and presence of mind to handle complaints and escalations
* Ability to Innovate and enhance procedures and methods to increase productivity \& cost effectiveness
* Professional level of both written and spoken communication for interactions with VAC staff

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Do you have experience in operations, project management, marketing operations or brand management? Are you a proactive, resourceful and dependable professional that thrives in small start\-up environments wearing multiple hats and managing multiple projects concurrently? Do you subscribe to the wisdom of working smarter not harder?



If you said yes to these questions, consider joining our team of thirteen (13\) dedicated professionals as our first Operations Manager! We’re looking for a high\-agency Operations Manager to work on\-site directly alongside the founder of a small, but growing, skincare company based in Concord, CA, that creates products that produce clinical results, while tapping into whole\-plant wisdom and focusing on inclusiveness in the beauty space.



The Operations Manager will serve as the central project manager and operational point person, helping coordinate product launches, marketing execution, manage the company’s social media, provide support to our vendors, our creative partners, our professional accounts, and our customers while handling the day\-to\-day business priorities. This is a hands\-on, roll\-up\-your\-sleeves position for someone who loves creating order from complexity, thrives in a fast\-moving entrepreneurial environment, and knows how to take ideas, priorities, and unfinished projects and move them through to completion without constant direction and/or oversight.


**Knowledge Skills and Abilities**


* At least three (3\) years’ experience in operations, project management, marketing operations, brand management, or a similar cross\-functional role in a start\-up environment.
* Demonstrable project management skills. Exceptionally organized, dependable, resourceful, and proactive with the natural ability to follow up and close loops.
* Proven track record managing multiple projects, partners, and deadlines without losing track of details. Can prioritize effectively without constant direction.
* Intermediate to advanced competency with Google Workspace Suite and/or spreadsheets.
* Intermediate to advanced competency with ChatGPT, Claude or other modern AI tools. Ability to use AI thoughtfully for writing, research, organization, project management, and workflow efficiency. Understands that AI is a working tool, not a substitute for judgment, fact\-checking, or strong writing.
* Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Asana, AirTable, MS Project).
* Familiarity with social media management platforms (e.g., Buffer, Hootsuite, Sprout Social).
* Familiarity with omni\-channel marketing tools (e.g., Klaviyo, OmniSend, ActiveCampaign).
* Strong written communication skills. Able to take rough notes, voice memos, feedback, or a creative brief and turn them into a strong first draft.
* Strong verbal communication skills. Comfortable communicating directly with customers, vendors, consultants, creators, and professional partners.
* Proven ability to create systems that make work easier rather than more complicated.


*Preferred Qualifications*


* Previous experience in the beauty industry.
* Project management certification (e.g., CAPM, PMP).
* Previous e\-commerce experience.
* Experience integrating diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into organizational decision\-making.
* Previous experience working in a start\-up environment with fast\-moving, creative principal(s).


*Personal Attributes*


* Professional maturity to maintain composure during shifting priorities and/or tight deadlines
* Proactive ability to anticipate and recognize operational needs and present solutions.
* Ability to recognize when to move independently and when something genuinely needs founder input.
* Strong work ethic with a learning orientation, particularly around technology.


**Physical Requirements**



This position works primarily in an open office environment while regularly accessing the warehouse/production areas. Able to perform the following duties with or without accommodation:


* Traverse between the office area and the warehouse/production floor frequently throughout the day to execute duties.
* Stand/sit for the duration of the scheduled shift. Sit at a desk, conference room or workstation for more than three (3\) hours at a time.
* Able to operate computer and mobile devices.
* Safely able to lift, move and transports items weighing up to 25 lbs.
* Communicate in clear speaking voice in person, before large audiences and over audio or video\-based communications applications (e.g., phone, Zoom).


**Compensation \& Benefits**



This is a full\-time, exempt on\-site position working Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with occasional evening and weekend hours (40 hours per week) at our Concord facility. The company offers a competitive compensation and benefit package including:


* Health \& Welfare Plans: The company covers 75% of employee premiums on our Kaiser Gold base plan with an optional buy\-up to either Kaiser Platinum or Anthem Gold PPO plans. Optional participation in dental coverage plans through Ameritas or MetLife and vision coverage through EyeMed or VSP. Optional participation in company retirement plan with annual employer discretionary contributions.
* Paid Time Off (PTO): Eligible to accrue up to ten (10\) days of PTO in their first year.
* Paid Holidays: Six (6\) paid holidays annually.


**How to Join the Team**



Please apply by visiting our Careers website. Due to our small team capacity, we are unable to respond to direct phone calls or emails. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States, as we are unable to sponsor visas, nor have any open positions eligible for the H\-1B program.

jobs.description:

At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**  

An Operations Supervisor is a key leader supporting the CVS Store Management team in planning and driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. When there is no manager onsite, the Operations Supervisor leads the store and supervisory staff, ensures that store operations run smoothly, and is responsible for ensuring the completion of all opening and closing procedures.


Essential Functions:


1\. Management

* Work effectively with store management and store crews

* Supervise the store’s crew through assigning, directing and following up of all


activities

* Effectively communicate information both to and from store management and crews


2\. Customer Service

* Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints




* Promote CVS customer service culture. (Greet, offer help, and thank)

* Handle all customer relations issues in accordance with company policy

and promote a positive shopping experience for all CVS customers


Provide colleagues personalized customer service feedback and coaching (E.g., myImpact coaching; myCustomer feedback; personal observations)

* Maintain customer/patient confidentiality


3\. Merchandise/Presentation

* Price merchandise

* Stock shelves

* Support the planning, execute the displays, sign and inventory of weekly,

promotional, and seasonal merchandise

* Support the planning, execute the display and maintenance of off\-shelf merchandise

 **Required Qualifications**

jobs.title: CCAC Regional Supervisor - Operations & Onboarding Support
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**


Location: Remote (California\-based required). Preference for Sacramento, Fresno, and Stockton areas  

Reports to: Program Manager, California Climate Action Corps  

Status: Full\-Time, Exempt  

Salary: $83,300–$89,100 annually (DOE)  

Start Date: Open until filled

  

Benefits:

* 3\+ weeks vacation
* 14 paid holidays \+ additional sick leave
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and mental health coverage
* 403(b) retirement plan
* Annual career development funds
* Remote position, but occasional travel throughout California expected

**About California Climate Action Corps (CCAC)**
------------------------------------------------


California Climate Action Corps (CCAC), a state service program led by California Volunteers, Office of the Governor, and implemented by Bay Area Community Resources (BACR), mobilizes emerging leaders to take direct climate action in communities across California. With over 400 fellows and 100\+ host partners, CCAC supports impactful service projects focused on urban greening, organic waste and edible food recovery, wildfire resiliency, and climate education and volunteer engagement. The program is rooted in service, equity, and sustainability.

### **Position Summary**


The Regional Supervisor – Operations \& Onboarding is a dynamic, multifaceted role responsible for both regional fellowship support and critical program operations for the California Climate Action Corps (CCAC). Approximately half of the role focuses on serving as a Regional Supervisor for a cohort of Fellows and Host Partners, while the other half focuses on owning key administrative, financial, compliance, and operational processes that support a 400\+ Fellow, 100\+ Host Partner Fellowship.


As a Regional Supervisor, this position serves as a primary program liaison across multiple Host Partner sites, providing ongoing support to Fellows and their Site Supervisors, conducting monthly virtual check\-ins and bi\-annual in\-person visits, supporting professional development, and helping ensure a successful Fellowship experience. On the operations side, this position will own high\-volume, detail\-oriented processes including timecard administration, reimbursements, financial reporting, and offer support for onboarding and offboarding, compliance tracking, and audits.

  

This role requires someone who can zoom in on the details while keeping the big picture in view. The ideal candidate is a proactive and organized self\-starter who takes ownership of complex processes, effectively manages competing priorities, and thrives in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Operations \& Finance**

* Own and manage the fellowship timecard approval process and reporting for 400\+ fellows, including reviewing, tracking, and resolving timecard issues
* Manage fellowship reimbursements, review documentation for accuracy and compliance, and coordinate timely processing
* Organize, prepare, and submit financial reports, ensuring information is accurate, complete, and submitted by required deadlines
* Coordinate key onboarding and offboarding processes for 400\+ fellows annually
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative systems and processes, taking initiative to create greater consistency, efficiency, and accountability
* Support program audits by maintaining organized records, gathering documentation, and responding to requests

### **Fellow Regional Supervision**

* Support the professional development of each AmeriCorps Fellow
* Help facilitate and plan member development training days, community building, and celebrations
* Act as Regional Supervisor for fellows and host partners, meeting virtually on a monthly basis and occasionally conducting in\-person site visits
* Collect all member evaluation and metrics reporting documentation
* Oversee and approve AmeriCorps timesheets, track AmeriCorps hours, and support fellow professional development and post\-fellowship transition

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree and 3\+ years of experience in one or more of the following:
	+ Program or operations administration
	+ Finance, financial administration, or grant administration
	+ Compliance, reporting, or audit support
	+ Onboarding or human resources support
	+ Stakeholder or partnership coordination
	+ Nonprofit, AmeriCorps, or other service\-oriented programs
* A highly organized, detail\-oriented self\-starter who can take ownership of complex processes from start to finish, manage high\-volume work and competing priorities, and maintain accuracy across multiple systems
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot issues, navigate challenging conversations, balance competing needs, and follow through
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to provide guidance and support to Fellows, Host Partners, and internal team members
* Adaptability and resilience in a fast\-moving environment, with the ability to adjust to changing program needs and priorities
* Strong remote\-work skills, including proactive communication, accountability, and responsiveness
* Experience with project management, reporting, Salesforce, Slack, Google Suite, or the ability to learn new systems quickly
* Experience with sustainability, environmental, or AmeriCorps programs, and familiarity with California environmental policy is a plus

**About Bay Area Community Resources**
--------------------------------------


Bay Area Community Resources (BACR) promotes the healthy development of individuals, families, and communities through direct services, volunteerism, and partnerships in California. Bay Area Community Resources is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Visit our website at www.bacr.org.

jobs.description:

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Council Bluffs, IA, USA; Midlothian, TX, USA; The Dalles, OR, USA; Leesburg, VA, USA; Lenoir, NC, USA; Sparks, NV, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program or project management.
* 8 years of experience in business strategy, operations, or program management, with a focus on designing and driving organizational processes.
* 8 years of experience managing organizational rhythms (e.g., monthly/quarterly business reviews, OKR tracking, leadership summits) or executing internal communication strategies for operations.
* 8 years of experience managing cross\-functional programs.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience in business operations or operational program management in a data center environment.
* 5 years of experience establishing business\-centric metrics, KPIs, and evaluation frameworks for complex organizations.
* Experience with designing and implementing process improvements or change management initiatives that resulted in measurable organizational efficiency gains.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross\-functional partners and leadership across a global team to drive operational improvements, particularly in ambiguous environments where engaged priorities exist.
* Strong executive leadership presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively to executive stakeholders.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


As a Business Strategy and Operations Program Manager, you will be a pivotal member of our enablement team, dedicated to removing friction and minimizing administrative burden for our Data Center Operations (DCOps) field teams. Your mission is to provide the operational clarity and process support necessary for our field teams to maintain focus on delivering operational excellence. Your responsibilities will include streamlining the OKR process, simplifying the Rhythm of Business (RoB), and executing a two\-way communication strategy that ensures field challenges are heard and addressed by leadership. You will require a service\-oriented mindset, focused on empowering our technical teams to work effectively by reducing the complexity and confusion that often accompany large\-scale operations.


Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $188000 \- $274000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Act as a team multiplier for our field teams by proactively identifying and eliminating operational bottlenecks and administrative friction that impede their daily work.
* Own the end\-to\-end OKR process for the organization, leading the setup, tracking, and alignment of OKRs while ensuring that objectives are clear, relevant to field needs, and designed to minimize reporting overhead.
* Organize and facilitate the regular meetings that keep the organization aligned, ensuring discussions are productive, and that critical blockers are identified and cleared.
* Build trusted partnerships across cross\-functional groups to drive operational improvements and ensure that initiatives are designed with business needs in mind.
* Look for ways to simplify how we work.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. * 8 years of experience managing organizational rhythms (e.g., monthly/quarterly business reviews, OKR tracking, leadership summits) or executing internal communication strategies for operations.
* 8 years of experience managing cross\-functional programs.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience in business operations or operational program management in a data center environment.
* 5 years of experience establishing business\-centric metrics, KPIs, and evaluation frameworks for complex organizations.
* Experience with designing and implementing process improvements or change management initiatives that resulted in measurable organizational efficiency gains.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross\-functional partners and leadership across a global team to drive operational improvements, particularly in ambiguous environments where engaged priorities exist.
* Strong executive leadership presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively to executive stakeholders.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


As a Business Strategy and Operations Program Manager, you will be a pivotal member of our enablement team, dedicated to removing friction and minimizing administrative burden for our Data Center Operations (DCOps) field teams. Your mission is to provide the operational clarity and process support necessary for our field teams to maintain focus on delivering operational excellence. Your responsibilities will include streamlining the OKR process, simplifying the Rhythm of Business (RoB), and executing a two\-way communication strategy that ensures field challenges are heard and addressed by leadership. You will require a service\-oriented mindset, focused on empowering our technical teams to work effectively by reducing the complexity and confusion that often accompany large\-scale operations.


Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $188000 \- $274000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits

--------------------

* Act as a team multiplier for our field teams by proactively identifying and eliminating operational bottlenecks and administrative friction that impede their daily work.
* Own the end\-to\-end OKR process for the organization, leading the setup, tracking, and alignment of OKRs while ensuring that objectives are clear, relevant to field needs, and designed to minimize reporting overhead.

jobs.title: Manager of People Operations (Bilingual, HR & Labor Relations)
jobs.description:
Pritchard Sports \& Entertainment Group seeks a Bilingual Manager of People Operations to manage day\-to\-day HR, personnel, payroll coordination, labor relations and office administration for a cleaning services account, venue. This hands\-on role supports a unionized hourly workforce, partners with site leadership and the client, and helps ensure staffing readiness and People readiness.


**Reports to:** Vice President of People Operations (HR), with functional guidance from the Site Manager


**People operations and workforce support**


* Partner with Recruiting and Operations on staffing needs, hiring, on site onboarding and retention. Complete and process new\-hire forms and required employment documentation; maintain accurate UKG (HRIS) records and confidential personnel files.
* Maintain current staffing rosters, vacancies and weekly termination reports. Coordinate timely separation processing with HR and Payroll, including required final\-pay information.
* Work with team leaders, supervisors and managers to evaluate performance and staffing needs; recommend adjustments for Site Manager approval and coordinate labor and materials readiness for assigned work.
* Conduct on site orientations, coordinate, facilitate employee and supervisor training, and track completion. Administer site benefit, incentive and recognition programs, including the Pin Ceremony, with corporate partners.
* Build trusted, supportive relationships with employees while maintaining professional boundaries and ensuring fair, consistent treatment.
* Coach leaders on attendance, performance, documentation and employee communication; remain accessible across shifts and coordinate appropriate workplace matters with the client while protecting confidential information.


**Union relations and employee investigations**


* Maintain productive relationships with union representatives and stewards. Administer collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) and guide leaders on seniority, manage seniority list, assignments and discipline.
* Manage grievance intake, fact\-finding, deadlines, meetings and documentation; recommend responses and resolutions with the Site Manager and VP of HR. Escalate settlements and contract commitments for approval.
* Conduct impartial investigations into employee concerns, harassment, discrimination, retaliation and policy violations. Document findings, recommend action and monitor follow\-up; escalate sensitive matters to the VP of HR and legal counsel.
* Review proposed discipline and terminations for policy and CBA consistency. Train supervisors on union interactions and support negotiations, mediation or arbitration with records and case preparation as assigned.


**Payroll and office administration**


* Prepare and process site payroll submissions in partnership with Payroll. Review timekeeping processes, attendance, pay adjustments, CBA pay provisions and approvals; resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate payroll records.
* Manage office administration, including correspondence, copying, filing. Use HRIS and office software to prepare reports and track deliverables.
* Maintain purchase\-order files, invoices, daily billing and billing reports; reconcile supporting documentation and coordinate timely approvals and submission with Operations and Finance.


**Claims and incident coordination**


* Maintain site insurance documentation, Workers’ Compensation records and injury, accident and General Liability reports. Collect incident details, witness statements and supporting records for timely submission to Risk and Safety.
* Track claims and missing documentation; coordinate work status, restrictions and return\-to\-work requirements with HR, Operations, Risk and Safety under approved guidance.


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Five or more years of progressive HR experience, including at least two years of hands\-on union relations, CBA administration and grievance management.
* Experience conducting investigations, coaching supervisors, supporting a large hourly workforce and coordinating payroll. Sports venues, hospitality, facilities services or event operations experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of California and San Francisco employment law and requirements; sound judgment, confidentiality, attention to detail and strong project coordination skills.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, including Excel, and proficiency with HRIS, timekeeping and reporting systems; UKG experience preferred. Ability to work effectively with employees, leaders, clients and vendors.
* Ability to work on site across multiple shifts, including evenings, weekends and holidays, to support the venue’s event schedule.


**Benefits**


* **Salary: $100,000– $110,000 Annually based on experience.**
* **Schedule: On Site; some evenings, some weekends and some holidays aligned with events**
* Health Benefits Package
* Ancillary benefits—Life insurance, Long Term Disability, FSA, and Dependent Spending care
* 401K
* Opportunity for growth


**Pritchard Industries participates in E\-Verify.**

#### **Behaviors**


Preferred* Thought Provoking: Capable of making others think deeply on a subject
* Functional Expert: Considered a thought leader on a subject
* Team Player: Works well as a member of a group
* Detail Oriented: Capable of carrying out a given task with all details necessary to get the task done well

jobs.title: Platform Program Manager, AMP Partner Operations
jobs.description:
Apple’s Partner Operations team is seeking an experienced, highly collaborative, and technically astute Program Manager to lead platform capability expansion across our Apple services partnerships.  

  

**Description**  

  

In this role, you will bridge business strategy, technical integration, and partner execution. You will guide global partners\-spanning telecommunications carriers, subscription video on demand (SVOD) providers, and retail integrators\-through the onboarding lifecycle, ensuring they can seamlessly adopt new platform capabilities. You will operate comfortably in the gray, translate complex commerce and linking architectures into actionable operational workflows, and drive alignment across Business Development, Engineering, Product, QA, Marketing, Legal, and more. You will also continue to refine parter onboarding and management processes and tools, utilizing innovative approaches \- knowing when to use technical tools such as AI while understanding the necessity for face to face collaboration. ","responsibilities":"You will own the end\-to\-end operational lifecycle for new platform features and major partner launches. Your core responsibilities include:  

  

Platform Capability \& Feature Onboarding  

  

Drive Partner Adoption of Platform Capabilities: Lead the operational rollout and partner adoption for emerging features to our billing platform.  

  

Partner with product and engineering teams to establish operational readiness for novel subscription bundling models (e.g., streaming and carrier bundles), tier upgrades/downgrades via update\-entitlement APIs, and multi\-country configurations.  

  

Define Migration \& Sunset Flows (CIP to Direct): Own the Partner Ops workstream for transitioning subscribers between partner\-billed and Apple\-direct models, defining end\-to\-end operational requirements, PVT validation flows, and subscription cancellation/revocation procedures.  

  

Technical Operations  

  

Lead Production Verification \& Testing Strategy: Partner with Commerce QA and Central Marketing UAT to define and execute comprehensive PVT plans; coordinate partner dependencies, including test SIM sourcing, test accounts, and allowlisting.  

  

Investigate Discrepancies \& Resolve Blockers: Triage operational and technical blockers impacting partner launches (e.g., deep\-link localization/offer sheet display issues, tax ID formatting on partner invoicing, missing commerce signals, and account unlinking edge cases).  

  

Operational Infrastructure \& Scalability  

  

Oversee intake trackers from the partner ops team and roadmap requests for platform enhancements; prioritize requests with engineering and product teams to balance partner velocity with long\-term platform health.  

  

Standardize Governance \& Enablement: Partner with regional teams (AMR, EMEIA, APAC) and integrators to deliver consistent integration best practices, partner capability trackers, and onboarding toolkits.  

  

Drive Process Automation: Identify manual intervention points across the onboarding lifecycle and work cross\-functionally to transition them into automated, self\-serve, and scalable tools.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

BA/BS degree required; technical, engineering, or business operations background preferred.  

  

8\+ years of relevant industry experience in technical program management, partner operations, or systems integration.  

  

Experience in telecommunications carrier billing, digital streaming services (OTT/SVOD), or digital commerce platforms is strongly preferred.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

8\+ years of technical program or operations management experience driving complex, partner\-facing integrations, digital customer journeys, and back\-end platform capabilities.  

  

Deep familiarity with subscription lifecycle mechanics, recurring billing, and API\-driven partner integrations  

  

Proven track record in end\-to\-end partner onboarding \& operational readiness, from defining intake processes and writing operational requirements to coordinating production verification testing (PVT/UAT).  

  

Strong cross\-functional orchestration skills, with the demonstrated ability to lead workstreams across Engineering, Product, Business Development, Commerce/Billing, Legal/Privacy, and Regional Operations teams globally.  

  

Strong analytical and problem\-solving aptitude, with experience troubleshooting back\-end event triggers, signaling mechanisms, and data\-flow discrepancies across multi\-party ecosystems.  

  

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of presenting technical concepts clearly to executive leadership, authoring partner\-facing integration guides, and managing multi\-stakeholder operational reviews.  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $149,700 and $225,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

jobs.title: Senior Medical Writer / Senior Project Manager, Clinical Evaluation
jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life\-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**Job Title**

**Senior Medical Writer / Senior Project Manager, Clinical Evaluation**

 **Working at Abbott**


At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit \- an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

 **The Opportunity**


We are seeking a Senior Medical Writer / Senior Project Manager, Clinical Evaluation to join Abbott’s Vascular Division on\-site in Santa Clara, CA or Maple Grove, MN. Abbott Vascular provides innovative, minimally invasive, and cost\-effective products for the treatment of vascular disease.

  

The primary function of a Senior Medical Writer / Senior Project Manager, Clinical Evaluation is to combine understanding of scientific and research methodology, medical device regulations and guidelines, and product and therapeutic area knowledge to support Regulatory Affairs medical device submissions in the EU for CE Marking of new devices and maintaining of CE Mark for existing devices in accordance with MEDDEV 2\.7/1 Rev 4, MDD, MDCG Guidance documents, and EU MDR 2017/745\.  

  



**What You'll Work On**

* Independently creates and maintains Clinical Evaluation Plans, Clinical Evaluation Reports, and Summary of Safety and Clinical Performance \[SSCPs], Regulatory Responses and other related documentation.
* Identifies, evaluates and summarizes clinical evidence including data from sources such as clinical investigations, literature, post\-market surveillance, risk, and post market clinical evaluations. Analyzes results in preparation for product applications and submissions.
* Creates, manages, or participates in timelines of deliverables by using appropriate project management tools.
* Clearly and timely communicates the timelines, project risks, and risk mitigation strategies with cross functional teams and medical writers.
* Interprets results in preparation for product applications by evaluating clinical and scientific and risk data and literature, and staying abreast of current clinical practice.
* Participate in and/or lead the development of regulatory responses for Notified Body questions upon review of submissions.
* Facilitate communication and exchange of documents between stakeholders (e.g., internal personnel such as Regulatory Affairs, R\&D Engineering, Clinical Engineering, A\&P and Marketing, Library Services, Quality Engineering, Post\-market Surveillance Group, Clinical Affairs, Risk Management, Program Management, as well as external vendors such as CROs, Medical Writers and Physician Reviewers).
* Provide strategic guidance on regulatory requirements, pertaining to clinical data and clinical evaluations, to new product development teams and sustaining teams.
* Participate in and support internal and external audits and responses to audit findings as appropriate, in root cause analysis, preventive or corrective actions, effectiveness monitoring, and other quality metrics.
* Function independently as a decision\-maker on CER\-related regulatory issues.
* Execute projects within budgetary guidelines.

 **Required Qualifications**

* A college degree (Bachelor’s) is required.
* Scientific/research background; training and degree in science, engineering, or medical fields; understanding of research design, methodology, and statistics.

jobs.description:

Tesla’s mission is to build a world of abundance and sustainability is the foundation of everything we do at Tesla. The Global Sustainability team seeks a Sustainability Reporting Project Manager to support Tesla’s sustainability reporting program. You’ll play a key role in helping project manage Tesla’s annual impact report, and related sustainability disclosures, working with stakeholders, globally. This is a high\-impact, high ownership and management role in a fast\-paced environment and ideal for someone who wants to contribute direction to Tesla’s mission while being a member of the Global Sustainability team.
  

**What You'll Do*** Project manage sustainability\-related reporting projects, including global sustainability regulations (i.e., CSRD, entity\-level reporting), Tesla’s annual Impact Report and business to business customer reporting requirements, related to sustainability disclosures (i.e., GHG emissions, waste, water, lifecycle assessments, circularity, human rights, workforce management)
