jobs.title: Sales Enablement & Training Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**


Construction is one of the largest industries in the U.S., but also one of the least technologically advanced. Every year, firms spend over $60B on teams creating cost estimates for bids. The process relies on tedious "takeoffs"—manually measuring and counting materials from drawings.


Bobyard automates takeoffs using computer vision and NLP, cutting estimate time significantly while reducing errors. We're a small team backed by Primary, Pear, and 8VC, building software for the construction industry.

 **Position Overview**


We're hiring our first dedicated Sales Enablement \& Training Manager to build the training, tooling, and content infrastructure behind our sales org. You'll own onboarding and ramp for new AEs and SDRs, sharpen our messaging for a notoriously hard\-to\-sell buyer (skeptical, hands\-on, trade\-vertical decision makers), and make sure reps have what they need to run a consistent, effective sales process — from first call to close.


This is a high\-ownership, build\-from\-scratch role. You'll work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product to translate what's working in the field into scalable playbooks, and you'll have a direct line to leadership on what's moving the needle.

 **Responsibilities**

* Build and own onboarding for every new AE and SDR, across every trade vertical we sell into
* Partner with our Sales Engineers to design and run a certification program reps have to pass before running demos or calls solo
* Partner with Sales leadership to identify skill gaps by stage of the funnel and build targeted training to close them
* Sit in on live calls and give reps specific, individual coaching — this is hands\-on, not just content
* Partner with Product on launch readiness — making sure reps can sell new features and verticals from day one
* Build and maintain trade\-specific playbooks that make it easier for new reps to sell
* Track ramp time and quota attainment by cohort, and use it to prove what's working and cut what isn't
* Own the enablement tech stack – ensuring reps are equipped and trained on the tools they use daily
* Coach managers on how to reinforce enablement content in 1:1s and deal reviews

 **What We're Looking For**

* 3\-5\+ years in sales enablement, sales training, or a related revenue role (AE/SE background a plus), ideally at a startup that's scaled quickly
* Experience building a training program from the ground up, not just maintaining an existing program
* Strong instincts for translating complex or technical product value into simple, repeatable selling language — especially for a buyer that isn't software\-native
* Comfortable with sales tooling and data (HubSpot or similar CRM; comfort with reporting/analytics a plus)
* Bonus: experience selling into construction, trades, or other traditionally offline/skeptical\-of\-software industries

 **Benefits**

* Competitive salary ($120K–$145K base), Bonus, 401K, and equity options
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus flexible PTO
* Direct impact on how the sales team grows, with ownership of the enablement function from the ground up
* Work alongside a driven team building something new in a large, underserved industry

 **SF\-based role: full\-time, in\-person in San Francisco (4 days/week)**  



We think our product stands out and the industry is ready for it. If you're excited to help us prove that out, we'd love to talk.

 **Comp Philosophy**

We are proud to offer competitive, top\-of\-market compensation because we want to celebrate the dedicated people who ship amazing work and drive our success. Our individual compensation is thoughtfully tailored based on your role, experience, and contributions, alongside performance\-based rewards.


Compensation Range: $120K \- $145K

Concurrent Technologies Corporation

As a trusted partner and leader in providing energy and sustainability consulting services to the federal government, Concurrent Technologies Corporation (CTC) understands the increasing complexity of achieving energy security and climate resilience in a changing world. We're Proof, a high\-growth startup in the legal tech industry, founded in 2017\. We offer a best\-in\-class legal services platform used by thousands of law firms and property management companies. Our platform enables law firms and collections parties to access efficient, transparent, and accessible legal and document delivery services, traditionally out of reach. We are on a path to double our business this year and are building a team to help us scale rapidly.



We welcome individuals from all backgrounds who are eager to help build a future where legal services are readily accessible, affordable, and efficient. If you have curiosity, passion, and a collaborative spirit to drive change in an outdated industry, we want you on our team.


**About the Role:**



We are hiring an Account Manager to own the post\-contract relationship for our Creditors' Rights accounts. You take the handoff from the sales team at contract signing and own everything from there: onboarding, ramp, retention, and growth. New logos are assigned to you throughout the year as they close.



The firms you will be managing file thousands of cases a month across multiple states, run formal audit programs, and hold their vendors to documented SLAs. You need to know their workflow, their plaintiff clients, and their operational requirements.

* Find and develop expansion opportunities within your existing book. New states, new plaintiff clients, new service types.
* You own the commercial conversation on expansion. You identify the opportunity, you propose and negotiate the expanded scope, and you onboard it.

* **Required**


	+ 3 or more years of account management or client services experience in a B2B environment. Experience working with creditors' rights law firms, law firms generally, or in the legal services space is strongly preferred.
	+ Strong organizational discipline. You manage a multi\-account book without dropping things, keep your notes and CRM current, and close every open item.

	+ Exposure to compliance\-driven client relationships with audit programs, vendor questionnaires, SLA reporting requirements, and formal review cadences.

jobs.title: Trust & Safety Coordinator
jobs.description:
#### **Trust \& Safety Coordinator**


We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Trust \& Safety Coordinator to join our Business Operations team at Introl. Reporting to the Global Safety Director, you will help build and run the program that governs the vetting, screening, conduct standards, physical and personal safety, and site access integrity of Introl's entire workforce, employees and contract field technicians alike. Our people work inside our customers' most sensitive facilities, often unsupervised and on compressed timelines. The trustworthiness of every person we put on a site, and their safety while they are there, is the product.


#### **Who we are**


At Introl, we specialize in large\-scale GPU cluster deployments, managing up to 100,000 of the most advanced GPUs available. Our experienced team works with leading\-edge technology, handling complex systems that are at the forefront of innovation.



Our approach goes beyond simple GPU connections. We design and execute highly coordinated deployments, integrating hundreds of thousands of fiber optic connections to build clusters that advance the limits of AI and high\-performance computing.


#### **Responsibilities**

#### **Workforce Vetting \& Screening**


Ensure screening programs are lawful and defensible in each operating jurisdiction (US federal and state, UK, Serbia), working with Legal and outside counsel on adverse action, disclosure, and data retention. Define and enforce re\-screening cadence, badge\-eligibility criteria, and disqualification and appeal procedures. Maintain evidence sufficient to satisfy customer audit and master service agreement obligations on personnel screening without a scramble.


#### **Field \& Site Safety**


Own the occupational health and safety program for field operations, including electrical safety, energized\-equipment work, lifting and rigging, ladders and lifts, hot/cold aisle conditions, PPE standards, and lone\-worker protocols. Establish job hazard analysis and pre\-task safety briefing requirements for deployment and migration projects. Drive incident, near\-miss, and injury reporting; run root cause analysis; track corrective actions to closure. Maintain OSHA recordkeeping and the equivalent UK and Serbian regulatory obligations; coordinate with carriers on claims and loss prevention. Align Introl safety practices to each customer's site\-specific safety program so technicians are ready on day one, not on day three.



Site Access \& Customer Trust



Define standards for customer site access, including badging, escorting, visitor and contractor protocols, media and mobile device restrictions, and photography controls inside customer facilities. Establish a code of conduct for technicians on customer premises and a clear, fast process for handling conduct complaints raised by customers. Serve as the escalation point for customer trust incidents; own the customer\-facing narrative, remediation plan, and follow\-up reporting. Support sales and account teams in security and safety questionnaires, site readiness reviews, and customer audits.


#### **Investigations \& Incident Response**


Lead investigations into workplace conduct, harassment, theft, property damage, safety violations, and misuse of customer access. Maintain a consistent, documented investigation methodology with defined severity tiers, timelines, and disposition standards. Coordinate with the Director of Risk and Compliance on incidents that cross into information security, so a single incident does not get handled twice under two playbooks. Interface with law enforcement, insurers, and customer security teams where circumstances require.


#### **Qualifications**


Demonstrated ownership of a background screening or personnel vetting program at a company with a distributed or contingent workforce



Working command of occupational health and safety regulation in at least one major jurisdiction, with the ability to extend a program into others



Direct experience conducting and documenting workplace investigations, including matters with legal or customer exposure



Sound judgment under pressure and the ability to hold a line with a revenue\-generating team when the safe or right answer is the inconvenient one



Clear, concise writing; this role produces policy, investigation reports, and customer\-facing correspondence that must hold up under scrutiny



Ability to travel to customer data center sites and to obtain and maintain access credentials required by our customers



Able to work in data center environments (noise, temperature variation, confined aisles, elevated work areas) and meet customer site entry and PPE requirements



Availability for occasional work outside standard hours to support incidents, customer escalations, and teams in UK and Serbia time zones



Preferred: Experience in data center, critical facilities, construction, telecommunications, or field services operations



Preferred: Familiarity with enterprise master service agreement security and safety clauses and the obligations they create



Preferred: Experience managing safety and screening programs across multiple countries, including the UK and Central or Eastern Europe



Must have legal authorization to work in the U.S. without requiring sponsorship now or in the future.


#### **Benefits and Compensation**


Overtime eligibility in accordance with federal and state law



Access to Introl employee benefits (where applicable based on eligibility), which may include:



Medical, dental, and vision coverage



401(k) plan



Paid sick time in accordance with state/local requirements



Opportunities for continued project assignments and career growth within Introl


#### **About Introl**


Accelerate the future of AI with Introl managed GPU deployments

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. We are led by a highly accomplished management team and provide a full suite of management services to its affiliated practices. UHP is currently affiliated with 182 providers consisting of 119 physicians and 63 advanced practice providers operating out of 54 locations across Southern, Central, and Northern California.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Sales Operations Manager**
============================


**Reports to:** Vice President, Sales


**Location:** Remote, United States


**Type:** Full\-time, exempt


**OUR COMPANY**


SimX is a fast\-growing company bringing virtual and augmented reality to medical simulation training. At the end of 2024, we were acquired by Madison Industries, a partnership that has provided a surge in resources to accelerate our growth and mission. Our professional\-grade VR system is the first of its kind, used by physicians, nurses, and paramedics to reduce medical errors and save lives. We are looking for a mission\-driven leader to help us continue this momentum and save lives through better training.


**THE JOB**


SimX is scaling across health systems, academic and commercial accounts, Military and Federal programs, international distribution, and emerging markets. As we continue to grow, the Sales Operations Manager will build and manage the processes, systems, analytics, and infrastructure that enable our Sales team to operate effectively and predictably.


This is a hands\-on builder role responsible for five core areas: deal desk management; sales performance and analytics; forecasting and pipeline management; territory, quota, and compensation; and sales systems and processes. The role will work closely with the VP of Sales and partner across Finance, Legal, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product and will manage 1 full\-time employee (FTE).


**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**


### **Deal Desk Management**


* Own the deal desk process from intake through handoff to Legal/Contracting, including pricing review, deal structure, approval routing, and required documentation.
* Maintain approved pricing, discount guidelines, and approval paths, and coordinate exceptions with the appropriate Sales, Finance, and Legal decision\-makers.
* Analyze deal economics and identify financial or commercial issues requiring escalation.
* Monitor deal desk turnaround time, discounts, exceptions, and recurring friction points and recommend improvements.


### **Sales Performance \& Analytics**


* Own Sales reporting and dashboards for pipeline, bookings, conversion, win/loss, sales cycle, quota attainment, and other key performance measures.
* Analyze Sales performance by rep, segment, and territory to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and provide actionable recommendations to Sales leadership.
* Partner with Finance to reconcile Sales bookings and pipeline data with company financial reporting.


### **Forecasting \& Pipeline Management**


* Run the weekly Sales forecast process, including submissions, deal reviews, forecast categories, rollups, and reporting.
* Monitor pipeline health, coverage, deal movement, close\-date changes, and gaps to target.
* Partner with the VP of Global Sales to improve forecast accuracy and with Finance to provide the Sales forecast as an input to company planning.


### **Territory, Quota \& Compensation**


* Build territory and named\-account assignments across segments in partnership with Sales leadership.
* Model Sales capacity, quota, and ramp against the annual bookings plan.
* Administer Sales compensation plans and SPIFs, including crediting rules, attribution between Sales and Customer Success, monthly commission calculations, and dispute resolution.


### **Sales Systems \& Process**


* Own administration and roadmap for the commercial tech stack, including Salesforce (system of record), pipeline intelligence and forecasting tools, sales intelligence and prospecting platforms. Ensures data quality, performs data audits, provides governance of sales systems.
* Establish and document scalable sales workflows, including stage requirements, MEDDPICC qualification frameworks, Mutual Close Plan standards, and territory allocation guidelines.
* Maintain effective Sales handoffs with Marketing, Legal/Contracting, Finance, and Customer Success.
* Lead rollout and adoption of Sales process and system changes and manage Sales technology vendors.


### **Minimum Qualifications**


* 7\+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or a related function, including experience at a senior individual\-contributor or management level.

**About the Business**
----------------------

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti\-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication \& Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https://risk.lexisnexis.com/  



  

**About our Team**
------------------

The Global Products \& Analytics (GPA) Project Management Office (PMO) is a strategic, cross\-functional team within LexisNexis Risk Solutions' Business Services organization that drives the successful delivery of high\-impact programs and enterprise initiatives. The team partners with product, technology, analytics, and business leaders to align projects with strategic priorities, foster collaboration, and deliver measurable business value through strong governance, innovation, and operational excellence. Working in a fast\-paced and evolving environment, the GPA PMO plays a key role in advancing solutions that help customers manage fraud, identity, financial crime, credit risk, and customer data challenges

  

  

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Senior Project Manager I, you will lead medium\-to\-large, complex projects and strategic initiatives that have enterprise\-wide impact. You will partner across multiple functions to drive alignment, manage delivery excellence, and ensure successful execution of key business priorities. This role offers the opportunity to influence decision\-making, navigate ambiguity, and help shape project management best practices while delivering meaningful outcomes.  



  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead and deliver medium\-to\-large, complex projects or multiple concurrent initiatives with enterprise impact.
* Define and execute project strategies, governance frameworks, and delivery standards aligned to organizational goals.
* Manage project roadmaps, dependencies, risks, and interdependencies across cross\-functional teams.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders; provide executive\-level communication and reporting.
* Influence decision\-making and alignment across Legal, Compliance, Data Privacy, Product, Marketing, Operations, and other functions.
* Ensure project performance tracking through KPIs and proactively mitigate risks.
* Mentor and guide junior project managers and contribute to continuous improvement of PMO practices.
Support go\-to\-market execution, including launch readiness, cross\-functional coordination, and post\-launch optimization (as applicable).  
* 

  

**Requirements**
----------------

* Experience: 5–9\+ years of project management experience, preferably within complex, cross\-functional or regulated environments.
* Proven ability to work independently and proactively drive initiatives forward.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to engage effectively with executive leadership.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives while managing changing priorities, challenging timelines, and resource constraints.
* Strong understanding of project governance, risk management, and performance tracking frameworks.
* Experience working in regulated environments (e.g., financial services, data privacy, compliance) preferred.
* Proficiency in project management tools such as Asana, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar platforms.
* Experience leveraging AI tools within project management practices.
* Certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile methodologies preferred.

jobs.title: AI Program Manager - Special Projects & Innovation
jobs.description:
Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS \& EPMS solutions for mission\-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program\-level governance.

  

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high\-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

 **Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.**

 **Position Title:** AI Program Manager — Special Projects and Innovation

**Position Location:** Remote — work virtually from anywhere in the United States, with occasional travel to job sites, lab environments, and company meetings

 **JOB SUMMARY**


Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS \& EPMS solutions for mission\-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program\-level governance. Our Special Projects and Innovation (SPI) group is where we pursue the ideas that do not fit inside a standard project — and it is the home of SmartTech.ai, our company\-wide AI enablement program.

  

AI adoption at STC has grown fast and organically: capable people across every department have built real tools and returned real time. That grassroots energy is our foundation — and it has outgrown an informal, team\-by\-team approach. As AI Program Manager, you will take SmartTech.ai from siloed experimentation to a governed, supported, and scalable capability — setting light\-touch policy and standards, standing up the development frameworks and hosting platforms that turn prototypes into deployable products, pairing the right tools to the right use cases, and raising the AI fluency of every employee through training, messaging, and hands\-on support.

  

This is STC's first dedicated AI enablement hire. You will report to the VP of Engineering \& Technology, operate within the SPI department, and coordinate a hub\-and\-spoke network of departmental AI Champions. You are equal parts builder and enabler — technical enough to architect and ship AI solutions yourself, and skilled enough with people and process to make the entire company better at using AI. You will receive general direction on objectives and work independently to build the program, communicating and operating in line with organizational goals and values as well as departmental objectives.

 **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

 **Program Governance, Policy \& Intake (20%)**

* Establish light\-touch, practical governance for AI use company\-wide — acceptable\-use standards, data\-handling and security guardrails, and a clear tool\-approval pathway — in partnership with IT and InfoSec
* Contribute to development of the innovation and idea intake (“funnel”), triaging incoming requests and prototypes and prioritizing them by value, effort, and risk
* Maintain a lightweight review cadence that keeps the program safe and consistent without slowing the people doing the work

 **AI Enablement, Training \& Messaging (20%)**

* Raise the AI fluency of the entire company — technical and non\-technical staff alike — through hands\-on training, office hours, documentation, and reusable prompt and workflow libraries
* Own internal messaging and change management for SmartTech.ai: announcements, wins, and adoption campaigns that build momentum and engagement
* Coordinate the departmental AI Champions network, turning individual wins into shared, company\-wide capability

 **Solution Development \& Deployment (20%)**

* Turn ideas and prototypes into deployable, supportable solutions — designing, building, and shipping LLM\-powered tools, agents, and integrations
* Serve as a hands\-on power user of Claude and modern AI development tools, setting the technical bar for prompt engineering, agentic workflows, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) over company knowledge, and API integration
* Harden and deploy high\-value prototypes built by others so delivery teams can rely on them without owning their maintenance

 **Development Frameworks \& Hosting Platforms (15%)**

* Design and stand up the sanctioned development environments, hosting platforms, and DevOps toolchain (source control, CI/CD, containerization, cloud hosting) that let AI solutions be built, deployed, and maintained safely and repeatably
* Replace ad\-hoc, unsanctioned workarounds with secure, documented, scalable infrastructure, in coordination with IT and InfoSec
* Establish reusable patterns, templates, and reference architectures for AI application development

 **Tool \& Use\-Case Portfolio Management (15%)**

* Evaluate, select, and manage the company's portfolio of AI tools and platforms; map tools to specific business needs and use cases so teams adopt the right tool for the job
* Track adoption, value, and ROI; maintain a prioritized roadmap of AI investments aligned to corporate growth targets
* Manage vendor relationships, licensing, and cost, and advise leadership on build\-vs\-buy decisions

 **Technology, Digital Tools \& AI\-Enabled Efficiency (10%)**

* Leverage AI\-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high\-quality work output
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance
* Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization
* Completion of assigned tasks and deliverables on time and on budget
* Performs other re

jobs.title: Training Manager – NFPA 70E
jobs.description:
**About JM Test Systems**


JM Test Systems provides calibration, test and measurement equipment, and technical services across multiple business segments and service locations. We help customers in industrial, energy, manufacturing, and other demanding environments keep critical instruments accurate, compliant, and ready to perform.

**Job Summary — The Opportunity**


Electrical safety training only works when it's practical, accurate, and delivered by people who know the trade. As our Training Manager, you'll lead the team that brings NFPA 70E training to our customers and help grow that training business.


In this role, you will lead our NFPA 70E Training Specialists and Coordinator, set direction for the program, and make sure every session meets the evolving needs of our clients. You'll still spend time in front of a class, facilitating training and building curricula, and you'll partner with our sales team on proposals, presentations, and customer relationships that expand our reach.


You'll thrive here if you're an experienced electrician and instructor who enjoys leading people, knows NFPA 70E inside and out, and likes helping customers see the value of great training.

**Key Responsibilities \& Outcomes**

We are expanding our provider network across the United States and are seeking motivated Provider Enrollment Specialists to introduce healthcare professionals and facilities to the platform. What You’ll Do As a Provider Enrollment Specialist, you will: \- Identify and contact healthcare providers and facilities throughout the United States. \- Introduce them to CashPayClinics.com and explain the benefits of joining the marketplace. \- Encourage interested providers to enroll and list their services and self\-pay prices. \- Assist providers with the enrollment process when necessary. \- Use your unique referral link, referral code, and QR code to track your enrollments. \- Conduct outreach through email, telephone, social media, professional networks, direct messaging, in\-person networking, or other appropriate marketing channels. Your referral link or code can be shared anywhere in the United States. You receive credit for qualifying providers or facilities that enroll through your assigned referral link or code, regardless of where they are located in the U.S. Who Can You Enroll? CashPayClinics.com is open to a broad range of healthcare and wellness professionals—not just physicians. Eligible providers may include: \- Primary care physicians and medical specialists \- Nurse practitioners and physician assistants \- Dentists and dental specialists \- Chiropractors \- Massage therapists \- Physical and occupational therapists \- Mental health professionals \- Dermatologists \- Plastic and cosmetic surgeons \- Podiatrists \- Optometrists and other vision professionals \- Weight\-loss and wellness providers \- Other eligible healthcare professionals offering self\-pay services Facilities may include medical practices, urgent care centers, laboratories, imaging centers, surgical centers, hospitals, and other eligible healthcare facilities. Compensation Individual Provider Enrollment: $150 Healthcare Facility Enrollment: $250 To qualify for payment, the provider or facility must become a paying subscriber and remain enrolled for at least 30 days. There is no fixed limit on the number of qualifying enrollments you can generate. For example: \- 10 qualifying individual providers \= $1,500 \- 20 qualifying individual providers \= $3,000 \- 10 qualifying facilities \= $2,500 These examples are illustrations only and are not guarantees of earnings. What Providers Pay Individual providers subscribe to CashPayClinics.com for $175/month. Healthcare facilities subscribe for $500/month. Subscriptions can be canceled at any time. CashPayClinics.com does not take a percentage of the provider's patient revenue. Providers establish their own self\-pay prices, and patients pay the provider or facility directly. Who We’re Looking For This opportunity may be a good fit for individuals with experience in: \- Healthcare marketing \- Medical or pharmaceutical sales \- Provider relations \- Business development \- Digital marketing \- Healthcare recruiting \- B2B sales \- Practice management \- Medical billing or healthcare administration An existing healthcare network is helpful but not required. We are primarily looking for people who are comfortable with outreach, can communicate professionally, and are motivated by performance\-based compensation. Because your referral link can be promoted nationwide, you are not limited to providers in your immediate geographic area. Apply to become a Provider Enrollment Specialist with CashPayClinics.com and help us build a nationwide marketplace for transparent, self\-pay healthcare. CashPayClinics.com Transparent Prices. More Choice. Simpler Self\-Pay Healthcare.

jobs.title: Payment Operations Specialist, Technical Operations
jobs.description:
**About FastSpring:**

FastSpring is how AI, SaaS, gaming, software, and digital product companies sell online in more places around the world. We handle all payment needs from checkout to taxes so you can go farther faster.

Founded in 2005, we are a privately owned company headquartered in Santa Barbara with offices in Amsterdam, Austin, Belfast, Dublin, Halifax, and Singapore.

**Payment Operations Specialist, Technical Operations**



Department: Payment Operations \| Location: Remote — United States \| Reports To: Senior Manager, Payment Operations


**Position Overview:**



The Payment Operations Specialist, Technical Operations supports daily payment operations across multiple processors and regions for FastSpring's network of more than 2,500 sellers. The role pairs hands\-on operational work — chargeback and PayPal dispute support, issue investigation, and seller\-facing resolution — with technical operations analytics across five areas: authorization rates, chargeback rates, data normalization, processing costs, and reconciliation support. It is an entry\-to\-early\-career position for someone curious about how payments work, comfortable in a spreadsheet, and inclined to chase down a number that looks wrong.



Within a year, this person should own recurring analysis in at least one of those five areas, handle disputes independently, and be the person others ask when a number doesn't reconcile — a path that leads toward senior payment operations, payments analytics, or risk and fraud. Payments is a field you learn by doing, and we welcome candidates from varied backgrounds and career paths; curiosity and analytical instinct matter more here than a specific résumé.


**Responsibilities \& Goals:**


* Support chargeback and PayPal dispute workflows — case review, evidence gathering, and representment preparation under guidance from senior team members — and coordinate with sellers and internal teams to collect supporting documentation.
* Monitor chargeback volumes, win rates, and fraud ratios against card network thresholds by seller, processor, and MID, and analyze disputes by reason code, product, and geography to separate fraud from service or billing causes.
* Investigate Tier I–II payment inquiries involving authorizations, declines, settlements, refunds, disputes, or processor behavior; escalate complex cases and maintain clear handoff notes, including for weekend coverage.
* Track authorization approval and decline rates across processors, regions, and payment methods, breaking declines down by response code and category to pinpoint where approvals are being lost.
* Normalize payment data across sources — processor response codes, decline and chargeback categories, and reporting definitions — and run routine data\-quality checks so figures from different systems are comparable.
* Track what payments actually cost by processor and region — interchange, scheme fees, acquirer markup, FX, and dispute fees — and check processor invoices and fee statements against expected rates, flagging anomalies or misapplied pricing.
* Support daily and monthly reconciliation across platform records, processor reports, and bank statements, investigating unmatched items and contributing to the reporting and SOPs that surface payment performance, cost, and dispute trends across the organization.


**Experience \& Qualifications:**


* 1\+ years of experience in payment operations, chargebacks, risk operations, customer support operations, finance operations, ecommerce operations, or a related field; experience in SaaS, digital goods, ecommerce, fintech, marketplace, or subscription businesses is a plus.
* Basic understanding of card payments, payment processors, PayPal, refunds, disputes, or the chargeback lifecycle; hands\-on experience and exposure to merchant\-of\-record environments are preferred but not required.
* Comfort working with data, dashboards, spreadsheets, and exported reports — able to pull a data set apart, summarize it, and tell when the result looks wrong.
* Curiosity about why a number moved and the persistence to find out, paired with strong attention to detail and a clear sense of accountability.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks across systems and queues while following documented processes accurately.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to ask good questions and document work carefully enough for someone else to pick it up.
* Willingness and ability to work a schedule that includes weekends, with two weekdays off.


**Technology \& Systems:**


* Comfortable in spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets); familiarity with reporting or BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI is preferred.
* Exposure to SQL, Python, APIs, or observability tools — or a genuine appetite to learn them.
* Experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to assist with documentation, data cleanup, research, and workflow improvement.
* Familiarity with processor portals, settlement files, or other reconciliation and accounting\-adjacent workflows is a plus; we expect these tools to be learned on the job rather than mastered on arrival.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!


**More about our team and company:**

  
**The Opportunity**
===================



We’re looking for a versatile Senior Revenue Operations Analyst who enjoys connecting the details to the bigger business picture. You’ll own sales compensation and tackle a range of other analytical and operational challenges that help Fleetio’s go\-to\-market teams perform at their best.



You’ll run the monthly commission process, maintain accurate plans, and help our teams understand and trust their payouts. Alongside that ownership, you’ll analyze performance trends, strengthen reporting, and improve the processes that support our revenue organization.



You might trace a commission discrepancy back to its source, investigate why conversion changed across a sales segment, or turn a manual workflow into a repeatable process using automation. You’ll identify problems, recommend solutions, and work with partners to implement those improvements.



This role is a strong fit for someone who thrives on variety, takes pride in precise execution, and wants to build both deep expertise and broad business understanding. You’re curious about how things work, comfortable learning unfamiliar processes, and motivated by making them better.



You’ll report to the Revenue Operations Manager and partner with Sales, Account Management, Finance, People Operations, Marketing, Enablement, and GTM Systems.


**Your impact**
===============



You’ll work across sales compensation, funnel analytics, and process improvement to help our revenue teams operate effectively and make informed decisions.


* Own the monthly sales commission process from data preparation and payout validation through handoff to Payroll, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and clarity for our teams.
* Translate approved compensation plans into precise payout calculations and comp letters, seamlessly managing updates for new hires, role transitions, and plan changes.
* Resolve data and payout discrepancies by identifying root causes, clearly explaining findings, and maintaining records of adjustments.
* Lead investigative funnel analyses from exploration to practical recommendations, uncovering growth drivers and shaping the team’s focus.
* Empower sales leadership with a clear view of pipeline health, conversion velocity, and revenue attainment through high\-impact reports and executive dashboards.
* Collaborate across teams on territory design, capacity planning, and target\-setting, using data to evaluate options and trade\-offs.
* Streamline recurring workflows in partnership with systems and operational teams, leveraging AI to reduce manual effort and maintain high accuracy.
* Document processes and business rules to ensure scalability, repeatability, and strong cross\-functional trust.

**What you bring**
==================


* 4\+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, Compensation Operations, Finance, or a similar analytical role in B2B SaaS or a recurring\-revenue business.
* You can explain a payout calculation to a rep, a performance trend to a leader, or a business requirement to a systems partner.
* You’re comfortable asking questions and respectfully challenging assumptions when the data points elsewhere.
* You’ve owned a recurring process or project from start to finish and made it better along the way.
* You can take an open\-ended question, structure the analysis, check your assumptions, and land on a recommendation with clear trade\-offs.
* You have a proven track record of building and auditing spreadsheet models using formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and quality checks.
* You have hands\-on experience with Salesforce (or a similar CRM) and QuotaPath (or similar commissions software).
* You learn unfamiliar areas quickly and can move between detailed operational work and broader business problems.
* You prioritize well, keep partners informed, and raise risks or decisions early.
* You’re curious about AI and automation and can spot practical ways to improve analysis and workflows, with thoughtful validation of the results.
### **Benefits**


* Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
* Vision insurance
* Incentive stock options
* 401(k) match of 4%
* PTO \- 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
* 12 company holidays \+ 2 floating holidays
* Parental leave \- birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non\-birthing (4 weeks paid)
* FSA \& HSA options
* Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid)
* Community service funds
* Professional development funds
* Wellbeing fund \- $150 quarterly
* Business expense stipend \- $125 quarterly
* Mac laptop \+ new hire equipment stipend
* Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks \& snacks (BHM only)
* Remote working friendly since 2012 \#LI\-Remote

Flowspace powers independent fulfillment, revolutionizing the way brands approach their supply chain. Our mission is to arm merchants with invaluable data, actionable insights, and seamless automation that transforms their supply chain into a strategic asset.  

  

At Flowspace, we lead the industry with our award\-winning, top\-tier fulfillment solutions. Powered by cutting\-edge software that offers unparalleled visibility and strategic insights, the Flowspace platform has been tailored for the tech\-savvy modern brands and retailers of today. Our innovative approach redefines fulfillment excellence, setting new standards in the ever\-evolving tech landscape.  

  

Join us as we shape the future of ecommerce and retail fulfillment. Backed by renowned investors such as Canvas Ventures, Moment Ventures, BuildGroup, Y Combinator, and esteemed angels, Flowspace is at the forefront of empowering brands in the dynamic $1 trillion ecommerce market to exceed customer expectations with seamless post\-purchase experiences.  

  

**Summary:**


The Strategic Account Manager is the owner of the client relationship and the ultimate driver of account retention for Enterprise Accounts. This role is responsible for building deep, multi\-threaded partnerships with key merchant stakeholders, driving adoption of Flowspace’s solutions, and delivering exceptional service that turns customers into brand advocates.

**What you'll do:**

	+ Ensure timely communication, responsiveness, and thoughtfulness in every customer interaction.
	+ Work closely with Operations, Product, Engineering, and Support teams to resolve issues quickly and strategically.
	+ Represent the merchant’s voice internally, advocating for timelines, escalations, and feature requests when needed.
* Week to Week:
	+ Drive weekly or bi\-weekly syncs, being fully prepared to speak to account\-specific metrics, open items, and business goals
* Month to Month:
	+ Develop QBR decks using the company template, tailored to merchant context and strategic objectives.
	+ Identify upsell and growth opportunities, and partner with internal leadership and Executive Sponsors to act on them.
* As Needed:
	+ Quarterback and project manage onboarding and launch for new merchants.
	+ Educate merchants on Flowspace’s platform, tools, and new product offerings to drive adoption and value realization.

**Who We’re Looking For:**

* 5\+ years proven experience in a former / current account management role
* Industry experience (logistics, warehousing, or ecommerce)
* Solid skills with software products, i.e. a WMS, Salesforce, GSuite
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work across teams, in a fast\-paced but collaborative environment

This role identifies and diagnoses business and performance needs, develops enablement strategies, and delivers solutions that improve seller effectiveness, productivity, adoption, and business outcomes.
  

  

The successful candidate combines business acumen, performance consulting, change enablement, content development, technology adoption, and project leadership. This individual is comfortable working independently, influencing stakeholders, and building solutions in a fast\-paced and evolving environment.
  

  

As Merative continues to advance as an AI\-forward organization, this role is expected to actively leverage AI, automation, analytics, and digital technologies to drive efficiency, improve knowledge access, enhance seller productivity, and scale enablement impact.**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales Leadership, developing a strong understanding of business priorities, sales goals, field challenges, and seller performance needs.
* Consult with leaders and sellers to identify capability, process, knowledge, adoption, and execution gaps and recommend solutions based on root\-cause analysis.
* Design, develop, facilitate and implement enablement programs aligned to business priorities and measurable outcomes.
* Create and maintain learning content, sales tools, communications, playbooks, videos, and other performance\-support resources.
* Support product launches, messaging updates, sales initiatives, process changes, technology adoption, and organizational change.
* Partner with frontline managers to reinforce learning, coaching, adoption, and ongoing development.
* Leverage sales enablement, CRM, analytics, automation, AI, and productivity technologies to improve efficiency, scalability, and business impact.
* Develop and manage content within sales enablement platforms such as Showpad or similar technologies.
* Measure enablement effectiveness and use feedback and performance insights to improve programs and resources.
* Lead multiple initiatives while collaborating with Sales, Product, Marketing, Operations, and other cross\-functional stakeholders.

jobs.title: Go To Market Manager
jobs.description:
Nelnet Business Services (NBS), a division of Nelnet, Inc., provides payment technology and education services to more than 1,200 higher education institutions, nearly 12,000 K\-12 schools, and millions of individual students, families, and supporters across the globe. Our culture of service enables us to form long\-lasting and trusted partnerships, while our focus on creativity and innovative solutions empowers our customer communities to thrive.


The GTM Launch Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing launch strategies for new products, services, programs, or initiatives. This role partners with cross\-functional teams to ensure successful market readiness, stakeholder alignment, customer adoption, and operational execution. The GTM Launch Manager develops and manages launch plans, identifies priorities and risks, and ensures resources, processes, and communications are in place to achieve business objectives. This role combines strategic planning with hands\-on execution to deliver successful and scalable launches.**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**
-------------------------

* Design and own the integrated go\-to\-market strategy and launch plan, defining the target audiences, positioning, channels, programs, priorities, resources, milestones, and measures of success required to successfully enter the market and scale.
* Develop and continuously refine the market positioning, messaging, buyer value propositions, competitive differentiation, and supporting tools needed to create awareness, communicate value, and enable the sales motion.
* Design and drive market activation and demand\-generation approaches, determining the right mix of campaigns, conferences, speaking opportunities, partnerships, customer advocacy, cross\-sell initiatives, and other channels to build awareness and qualified demand.
* Build the sales enablement and market\-facing resources required to support growth, including objection handling, competitive resources, customer references, case studies, outcome stories, and RFP and procurement support.
* Translate customer, sales, competitive, and market feedback into GTM decisions, using what the team learns to refine messaging, programs, channels, and priorities as the product enters the market.
* Determine the internal and external capabilities needed to execute the GTM strategy; scope, select, brief, and manage agencies, contractors, and other partners while coordinating effectively with key internal stakeholder teams.
* Define the measures and operating rhythm needed to evaluate GTM performance, assess what is and is not working, and recommend where to adjust priorities, resources, channels, or investment.
* Continuously evaluate the overall GTM approach, identify gaps and opportunities, and proactively recommend and implement changes needed to build a repeatable and scalable growth engine.

**REQUIREMENTS AND SKILLS**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* 7\+ years of progressive experience in go\-to\-market strategy, product marketing, product launch, growth marketing, commercialization, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience designing and executing the go\-to\-market strategy for a net\-new product, including determining target audiences, positioning, channels, programs, resources, and measures of success.
* Demonstrated experience taking a new product from pre\-launch through market entry and establishing a repeatable GTM approach to support growth.
* Deep understanding of how positioning and messaging, demand generation, sales enablement, customer advocacy, events, partnerships, channels, and measurement work together as part of an integrated GTM strategy.
* Proven ability to evaluate a market opportunity, identify what is needed to successfully go to market, make informed recommendations, and translate strategy into execution.
* Experience leveraging internal teams, agencies, contractors, and other external partners to execute a GTM strategy, with the ability to determine where specialized expertise or additional capacity is needed.
* Strong analytical, communication, and cross\-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence decisions and drive outcomes across teams without direct authority.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience within K–12 education or education technology.
* Experience launching or scaling products in public\-sector or complex B2B buying environments.
* Experience with education procurement, RFPs, customer reference programs, conferences, partnerships, or channel development.

  

Pay Range for this role is \- $125,000 \- $150,000 depending on experience


Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, HSA and FSA, generous earned time off, 401K/student loan repayment, life insurance \& AD\&D insurance, employee assistance program, employee stock purchase program, tuition reimbursement, performance\-based incentive pay, short\- and long\-term disability, and a robust wellness program. **Company: Certified Technical Experts**

**Rate: Open – Full Time**

**Position Summary**

* Certified Technical Experts, Inc. (CTE) is seeking an experienced Technical Writer / Training Specialist to develop clear, accurate, accessible technical documentation and training materials for Federal public health technology users, administrators, and project teams. This role transforms complex technical and operational information into practical user guides, procedures, learning content, release documentation, and knowledge resources.

* Develop, edit, and maintain user guides, standard operating procedures, technical manuals, quick\-reference materials, FAQs, and knowledge\-base content.

* Work with Product Managers, engineers, analysts, support staff, and subject matter experts to capture accurate technical and functional information.
* Translate complex technical concepts into concise, user\-friendly documentation and training content.
* Maintain documentation version control and update materials as product capabilities and procedures change.
* Support release communications, onboarding materials, implementation guides, and training schedules.
* Facilitate training sessions, demonstrations, workshops, and knowledge\-transfer activities as needed.
* Apply accessibility and plain\-language principles to documentation and training deliverables.
* Collect user feedback and support continuous improvement of documentation and learning materials.
* Maintain organized documentation repositories and publishing workflows.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6\+ years of technical writing, instructional design, training, or documentation experience for Federal IT or complex technology environments.
* Demonstrated experience developing user guides, procedures, curricula, training materials, and knowledge content.
* Ability to understand complex software functionality and explain it clearly to varied audiences.
* Experience collaborating with technical subject matter experts and Agile product teams.
* Strong writing, editing, information architecture, and content\-organization skills.
* Experience with documentation portals, collaboration platforms, and common authoring tools.
* Understanding of accessibility and plain\-language requirements for Federal content.
* Strong facilitation and presentation skills for training delivery.

**Education**

**Preferred:** Graduate education or advanced training in technical communication, instructional design, or adult learning.

* Federal health IT or public health documentation experience.

new_jobs.title: Community Health Advocate / Child Watch
new_jobs.description:
#### **POSITION SUMMARY:**


The Community Health Advocate (CHA) / Child Watch under the supervision of the Program Manager \- BIH, provides on\-site supervision to children ages 1 month to 12 years while parents attend prenatal, postpartum, and/or other BIH related group activities. Knowledge of appropriate child development theories and practices. Ability to create and maintain a safe learning environment for children. Ability to work effectively with children, parents, and program staff. Effective oral and written communication skills; sensitive to the needs of small children. May work up to 20 hours per week as needed for program demands.


#### **QUALIFICATIONS:**


1\. Education: High school diploma or equivalent. A typical way of obtaining the knowledge, skills and abilities outlined above is completion of six (6\) units of early childhood education or child development (with a grade of “C” or better) from an accredited college/university; or 4 months of ROP Training in a Child Development Program.


2\. Certification: Certification in Infant and Pediatric CPR and First Aid must be met within 30 days of assignment. Must successfully pass the background check. NegativeTB test required upon hire and must be maintained every four (4\) years.


3\. Brand Ambassador: Ability to project a positive image to the public.


4\. Experience: At least one (1\) year of experience working as a childcare aide, teacher aide or higher position.


5\. Mental and Physical Skills: The Community Health Advocate (CHA) / Child Watch occasionally is required to climb, stoop, kneel, or crouch. Frequently required to talk or hear. Ability to lift children up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus to view documents. Regularly required to use oral communication skills; read information and documents; solve problems; and establish and maintain effective working relationships with BIH program staff, participants (parents) and their children ages 1month – 12years.


6\. Interpersonal and Time Management Skills: Active listening, empathy, and cultural competence required. Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing in a professional manner. Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment, with rapidly shifting priorities and competing demands while maintaining attention to detail.


7\. Other: Ability to remain calm and courteous in a high stress environment. CHA / Child Watch should be able to work independently with minimal direction.

#### **EXAMPLES OF DUTIES:**


1\. Sets up child watch room/area prior to arrival of children.


2\. Assists in developing and maintaining a safe environment for children.


3\. Ensures that children engage in age\-appropriate activities/play (including watching of movies or videos);


4\. Provides emotional and physical support as appropriate to children and encourages high self\-esteem.


5\. Escorts of children who are toilet trained in the restroom and may change diapers for other children as needed.


6\. Supervises snack\-time (food to be provided by BIH program or child’s parent). Cleans up child watch room/area at the conclusion of child watch assignment.


7\. Other Duties as Assigned. Child Watch will attend and actively participate in training and care coordination meetings. This includes, but is not limited to, assisting with Black Infant Health Program events for BIH participants.

#### **GENERAL REQUIREMENTS:**


1\. Attends work regularly and punctually.


2\. Provides care appropriate to the age of the infants / children served


3\. Works cooperatively with BIH Program Coordinator, Public Health Nurse, Mental Health Professional, Community Outreach Liaison, BIH staff members, and other Baywell Health staff persons, as required.


4\. Treats all participants / clients / visitors with respect and courtesy.


5\. Remains competent in skills required for position.


6\. During the initial thirty (30\) days of employment, becomes and remains knowledgeable about and in compliance with Baywell Health and Black Infant Health Program policies and procedures in the following areas:


a. Confidentiality of patient / participant / fellow employee and supplier records b. Professional and business ethics.



c. Continuous quality and improvement.



d. Safety and security of person and property.



e. Infection control.



f. Hazardous materials and waste.



g. Life safety and emergency preparedness.


#### **About Baywell Health**


There’s healthcare and then there’s Baywell Health: your trusted partner in enhancing the health and dignity of the Bay Area’s Black community. We are dedicated to promoting optimal health and well\-being through compassionate, comprehensive care that values and supports every individual and family we serve. Our services span Gynecology \& Women’s Reproductive Adult Medicine Optometry Pediatrics Behavioral Health Oral Health Assisted Treatment Pharmacy Healthy Communities Covid\-19 Services We welcome you to apply here and join our team delivering healthcare to the community.

new_jobs.title: Black Infant Health - Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
#### **POSITION SUMMARY:**


The Black Infant Health (BIH) Program is meant to address the problem of poor birth outcomes and health disparities that affect African American women and their babies. The BIH program features a standard set of services that features group intervention and social service case management to help reduce stress, build resilience, promote healthy behaviors, and increase social support. The BIH Program Manager will have day to day responsibility for leadership of the BIH program and oversee all program team members and partners. This includes developing relationships with community\-based collectives, community\-based organization partners, and management of the Community Advisory Board. The position also includes management of project timelines and deliverables for timely and effective execution of the Work Plan and responsibility for project reporting. Ongoing and timely communication with Alameda County Public Health Department and other community partners will be expected as well. This position supports Alameda County’s BIH Program Area 2, covering families who reside in West Oakland, Emeryville, North Oakland and South Berkeley.


#### **QUALIFICATIONS:**


1\. Education: Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university program in Social Work, Public Health, Nursing, Education, Health Education, or other health related or social science field plus five years of management experience in a health/public health or social service setting is required; or Master’s Degree from an accredited college or university program in Social Work, Public Health, Nursing, Education, Health Education, or other health related or social science field.


2\. Experience: Lived understanding of African American culture and history, and general working knowledge of family systems, community trauma, and community organizing or advocacy. Experience in serving Black birthing and parenting individuals, providing family support, and offering home visiting services is key. At least five years of professional administrative experience in public health or a related field, including two years of supervisory experience.


3\. CA Department of Public Health Approval: The BIH Program Manager must be approved by the California Department of Public Health (CDPH)/Maternal Child and Adolescent Health (MCAH) BIH Program Consultant prior to appointment.


4\. Black Infant Health Ambassador: Fully embraces and supports the Black Infant Health Governing Concepts of culturally relevant, client\-centered, strength\-based, and cognitive skill\-building approaches.


5\. Cultural Competence: Demonstrates cultural competence. Demonstrates ability to implement and maintain a culturally relevant BIH Program that recruits, trains, and retains staff who reflect and respond to the values of the African American community served by BIH.


6\. Knowledge of Public Health: Demonstrates knowledge of the following: women’s health, including prenatal and postpartum health; life course perspective; infant behavior and development; health education, including breastfeeding, nutrition, and physical activity; and local community and social services.


7\. Advocacy and Outreach Skills: Essential qualifications focus on strong community engagement, population\-based assessment, and evidence\-based service delivery skills, particularly in women's health, infant behavior, health education, and addressing health inequities affecting the Black community. Advocacy and outreach skills will be essential to promote health equity by implementing health programs and health policies that will benefit the community’s health through motivational training.


8\. Interpersonal and Leadership Skills: Possess strong leadership skills. Demonstrates the organizational and interpersonal skills needed to communicate at different levels and work in complex situations. Reflects basic skills of the Health Resources and Services Administration Maternal Child Health Bureau Leadership Competencies 1\-8 (leadership.mchtraining.net).


9\. Computer Skills: Basic computer skills, and capable of using software and technology tools used to manage health data and reporting tools (Excel, Microsoft word, etc.). Experience in managing and tracking health data, navigating Epic and Tableau a plus.


10\. Other: Should be able to remain calm and courteous in a high stress environment. Should be able to work independently with minimal direction.

#### **EXAMPLE OF DUTIES:**


1\. Program Management: Responsible for the management and coordination of local BIH program activities and staff. Maintains confidentiality and adheres to Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) regulations. Provides supervision and professional development for staff; including assignment responsibilities and preparing performance evaluations. Prepares the BIH program budget and monitors expenditures. Prepares administrative, financial documents and transactions for completion, and gathers and compiles information for biannual reports.


2\. Conduct community outreach and need assessments. The BIH program manager will plan, develop, and provide oversight outreach campaigns to enroll pregnant African American women into the Black Infant Health program. Will conduct needs assessments and guide the research, and analysis of statistical and other data to report healthy birth outcomes and effectiveness of the BIH program. Will develop outreach and program literature to raise awareness of African American infant and maternal mortality rates.


3\. Program reporting and grant writing. Manages BIH scope of work to meet annual objectives; evaluates program needs and develops effective program activities and services to educate and empower clients in meeting their healthcare and related needs. Research and write grant proposals and agenda reports.

new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use.  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers across all industries and sizes—including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Healthcare, Industrial and Manufacturing, Media and Entertainment, Telecom, Big Data, and more—gain the best value and service from AWS?

This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises—serving as their advocate to AWS product teams.

As a Senior TAM, you will craft and execute technical cloud strategies to drive customers adoption and use of AWS services. Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

------------------------

* 5\+ years of design/implementation/operations/consulting with distributed applications experience
* 5\+ years of technical engineering experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in a 24x7 operational services or support environment
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead
* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Understanding of the AWS Well\-Architected Framework pillars and ability to properly apply them to existing or new customer architecture, implementations, and/or solutions

new_jobs.description:
Working at Regis University


As Regis employees, we embrace our Jesuit Catholic values of respect, inclusion and equity, and welcome employees, faculty and students from all faiths and cultures. Together, we perform our duties in alignment with the mission of the University and seek dedicated individuals to contribute to and strengthen that mission and our service to students. Why Work at Regis?


Job Summary:


The Grant Project Manager provides strategic and operational leadership for the federally funded TPSID grant at Regis University. This role oversees all aspects of compliance, reporting, and collaboration associated with the TPSID grant, ensuring alignment with the project’s objectives to promote inclusive higher education and transition\-to\-employment outcomes for students with intellectual disabilities.
Major Duties and Responsibilities:


**Grant Management \& Compliance**

* Manage all administrative and financial aspects of the TPSID grant, ensuring compliance with federal regulations, institutional policies, and sponsor requirements.

  

• Prepare and submit annual performance reports, continuation applications, and financial statements. • Monitor grant expenditures and coordinate with Financial Affairs to maintain fiscal accountability. • Lead documentation and evaluation processes in partnership with external evaluators.  



  

**Data, Evaluation \& Reporting**

* Collaborate with the evaluation team to ensure collection of valid, reliable data on student outcomes and program performance.

  

* Interpret evaluation findings to guide continuous improvement and program sustainability.

  

* Support dissemination of program results through conferences, publications, and community presentations.

  

**Program Support**

* Develop training recommendations for grant\-funded personnel including Transition Specialist, and student employees (Peer Mentors and Community Assistants).

  

* Support the Global Inclusive Program team to ensure effective collaboration across departments (Academic Affairs, Student Life, Disability Services, Career Services, etc.) as it relates to grant activities.

  

* Serve as the primary institutional representative to the U.S. Department of Education and national TPSID networks.

  

**Partnership \& Community Engagement**

* Develop and sustain partnerships with local school districts, the Colorado Department of Vocational Rehabilitation, employers, and community organizations.

  

* Promote inclusive employment pathways for GLOBAL students and alumni.

  

* Represent the program’s TPSID grant in state, regional, and national forums on inclusive postsecondary education.

  

* Identify opportunities for additional funding, grants, and philanthropic support to sustain and expand the program beyond the initial grant period.

  

Required Qualifications:


* Master’s degree in Education, Special Education, Higher Education Administration, Counseling, Social Work, or related field.
* At least five years of progressively responsible experience in grant management, program leadership, or administration within higher education or nonprofit settings.
* Demonstrated knowledge of inclusive higher education practices and/or transition services for students with intellectual disabilities.
* Experience managing budgets, supervising staff, and ensuring regulatory compliance.
Strong organizational, communication, and relationship\-building skills.  
* 

  

Preferred Qualifications: (Any of these would be helpful.)


* Doctorate in Education or related discipline preferred.
* Experience with federal grants, particularly TPSID or similar postsecondary education initiatives preferred.
* Knowledge of evaluation and data collection methods for program assessment.
Familiarity with Jesuit and mission\-driven education environments  
* 

  

**This position will remain posted until filled, with a preferred application deadline of October 16th, 2026\. Applications received by this date will receive full consideration.**

  

**Special Instructions to Applicants:**  

Please submit a resume, cover letter and list of references with your application. Current employees, please submit an application by logging into Workday. Click on Organization\>Jobs Hub to access the internal site.

* Comprehensive group health insurance, including medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance.

new_jobs.title: Trust & Safety Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
#### **Trust \& Safety Coordinator**


We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Trust \& Safety Coordinator to join our Business Operations team at Introl. Reporting to the Global Safety Director, you will help build and run the program that governs the vetting, screening, conduct standards, physical and personal safety, and site access integrity of Introl's entire workforce, employees and contract field technicians alike. Our people work inside our customers' most sensitive facilities, often unsupervised and on compressed timelines. The trustworthiness of every person we put on a site, and their safety while they are there, is the product.


#### **Who we are**


At Introl, we specialize in large\-scale GPU cluster deployments, managing up to 100,000 of the most advanced GPUs available. Our experienced team works with leading\-edge technology, handling complex systems that are at the forefront of innovation.



Our approach goes beyond simple GPU connections. We design and execute highly coordinated deployments, integrating hundreds of thousands of fiber optic connections to build clusters that advance the limits of AI and high\-performance computing.


#### **Responsibilities**

#### **Workforce Vetting \& Screening**


Ensure screening programs are lawful and defensible in each operating jurisdiction (US federal and state, UK, Serbia), working with Legal and outside counsel on adverse action, disclosure, and data retention. Define and enforce re\-screening cadence, badge\-eligibility criteria, and disqualification and appeal procedures. Maintain evidence sufficient to satisfy customer audit and master service agreement obligations on personnel screening without a scramble.


#### **Field \& Site Safety**


Own the occupational health and safety program for field operations, including electrical safety, energized\-equipment work, lifting and rigging, ladders and lifts, hot/cold aisle conditions, PPE standards, and lone\-worker protocols. Establish job hazard analysis and pre\-task safety briefing requirements for deployment and migration projects. Drive incident, near\-miss, and injury reporting; run root cause analysis; track corrective actions to closure. Maintain OSHA recordkeeping and the equivalent UK and Serbian regulatory obligations; coordinate with carriers on claims and loss prevention. Align Introl safety practices to each customer's site\-specific safety program so technicians are ready on day one, not on day three.



Site Access \& Customer Trust



Define standards for customer site access, including badging, escorting, visitor and contractor protocols, media and mobile device restrictions, and photography controls inside customer facilities. Establish a code of conduct for technicians on customer premises and a clear, fast process for handling conduct complaints raised by customers. Serve as the escalation point for customer trust incidents; own the customer\-facing narrative, remediation plan, and follow\-up reporting. Support sales and account teams in security and safety questionnaires, site readiness reviews, and customer audits.


#### **Investigations \& Incident Response**


Lead investigations into workplace conduct, harassment, theft, property damage, safety violations, and misuse of customer access. Maintain a consistent, documented investigation methodology with defined severity tiers, timelines, and disposition standards. Coordinate with the Director of Risk and Compliance on incidents that cross into information security, so a single incident does not get handled twice under two playbooks. Interface with law enforcement, insurers, and customer security teams where circumstances require.


#### **Qualifications**


Demonstrated ownership of a background screening or personnel vetting program at a company with a distributed or contingent workforce



Working command of occupational health and safety regulation in at least one major jurisdiction, with the ability to extend a program into others



Direct experience conducting and documenting workplace investigations, including matters with legal or customer exposure



Sound judgment under pressure and the ability to hold a line with a revenue\-generating team when the safe or right answer is the inconvenient one



Clear, concise writing; this role produces policy, investigation reports, and customer\-facing correspondence that must hold up under scrutiny



Ability to travel to customer data center sites and to obtain and maintain access credentials required by our customers



Able to work in data center environments (noise, temperature variation, confined aisles, elevated work areas) and meet customer site entry and PPE requirements



Availability for occasional work outside standard hours to support incidents, customer escalations, and teams in UK and Serbia time zones



Preferred: Experience in data center, critical facilities, construction, telecommunications, or field services operations



Preferred: Familiarity with enterprise master service agreement security and safety clauses and the obligations they create



Preferred: Experience managing safety and screening programs across multiple countries, including the UK and Central or Eastern Europe



Must have legal authorization to work in the U.S. without requiring sponsorship now or in the future.


#### **Benefits and Compensation**


Overtime eligibility in accordance with federal and state law



Access to Introl employee benefits (where applicable based on eligibility), which may include:



Medical, dental, and vision coverage



401(k) plan



Paid sick time in accordance with state/local requirements



Opportunities for continued project assignments and career growth within Introl


#### **About Introl**


Accelerate the future of AI with Introl managed GPU deployments
